hostel_campus.college_name: IES MCRC Infrastructure Details & Reviews

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied with the overall experience and placements are the worst.
reviews.review_text: Not at all hygienic. Very poor infrastructure. I was very disappointed with the infrastructure of certain elements. The classrooms are cramped and not maintained well. The Wi-Fi is never working, and the washrooms are the worst to experience. No parking facility is provided by the college.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IES's Management College and Research Centre.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is lacking compared to other colleges. They turn off Wi-Fi during exams, and there's no proper gaming room. The cafeteria only has CCD, but the ground-floor canteen is better. Overall, the atmosphere feels more like a school.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has good value for money.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is good. We have a games room, cafeteria, and canteen. Classrooms are well-equipped. The library has many books and journals. The computer lab is great. They provide personal laptops.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has a good value for money.
reviews.review_text: Our college is Wi-Fi enabled. Classrooms are equipped with air-conditioners. A gigantic library is available in our college. It has many books. We have an air-conditioned games room. We have table tennis, carrom, and chess.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied because of its teachers, placements, infrastructure, facilities, etc.
reviews.review_text: IES is one of few colleges that have introduced new course elements like universal human values and such. The course will help students to reach different in life with proper values. The infrastructure is average. Kindly people should look into the business analytics course offered by IES as this is the new tomorrow in the field of management.

reviews.review_heading: It has dedicated staff with all passion to make a difference in the student's life.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities are good for outstation students. There are proper rules with proper amenities provided in the hostel. The college canteen provides very hygienic food to all students. There is a computer lab with Wi-Fi where we can sit and do our projects.

reviews.review_heading: I am totally satisfied with my experience in this college so far.
reviews.review_text: The food and Wi-Fi facilities provided in the college are quite good and up to the standard. However, one thing which could be improved upon would be the prices of canteen food as it is slightly on a higher side as compared to other places. Apart from that, the rest is fine.

reviews.review_heading: I am extremely satisfied with IES Management College.
reviews.review_text: Our classrooms are well-equipped and clean with Wi-Fi and air-conditioning facilities. Additionally, there is a sports room nearby our classrooms for a quick change. Canteen with best of their food services at a faster delivery rate and friendly staff around.

reviews.review_heading: Great environment and good internships.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is well developed. There is a library which is available to the students. A wide range of books is available here. Apart from the library, there is also an auditorium where guest lectures are conducted. Also, the college has a computer lab which is used for conducting practicals.

reviews.review_heading: Inspite of the COVID-19, the college has made sure to help us with a good amount of exposure.
reviews.review_text: The entire campus is Wi-Fi enabled. Classrooms are air-conditioned and spacious. Libraries have various books and a lot of management books. We also have E-library which is accessible in the college as well as home. This helps a lot in the research and gives us a wide range to expand our knowledge.

reviews.review_heading: College with good placement opportunities and makes students industry-ready.
reviews.review_text: The campus is Wi-Fi enabled. Classrooms and libraries are accessible throughout the day. The library facilities are good. We have access to the E-Library and we can access it from our home as well in this lockdown when we are not able to come to college. Classrooms are air-conditioned and very spacious. The food served in the cafeteria and canteen is good and healthy.

reviews.review_heading: IESMCRC- A great learning experience.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is basic but at a prime location. College is acquired with all the latest facilities needed for the students. College also has inhouse CCD on the first floor for the students. It also has a well equipped library and also E-library.

reviews.review_heading: Above average management college with the best industry exposure.
reviews.review_text: The classroom and the campus are fully Wi-Fi equipped. Classes are very clean and the library is full of books and even have access to books and research papers. Hostel stay is good. They don't have food facilities. Students have to arrange that by themselves. Boys and girls hostel is separate.

reviews.review_heading: It's a decent mid- tier B-schools located in the heart of the city.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are well-equipped. Cafeteria & canteen are good. Canteen has a variety of options. Library has a lot of options. Apart from cafeteria there are several free spaces where students can spend free time. Sadly Labs & Hostel facility are average.

reviews.review_heading: A big YES if you wish to pursue Marketing!
reviews.review_text: The canteen is very good in terms of everything here. We have a gymkhana which just has few carrom boards and two table tennis tables. The campus is shared with the IES school and also IES architecture college. But there is a whole different building for management with well-equipped classrooms.

Dr Vijay Bhangale (B.Pharm., M.M.S., Ph.D), Director at IES’s Management College and Research Centre, Bandra, holds industry experience of 17 years in Marketing with companies like Ranbaxy Labs, Glaxo Smith Kline, Searle, Merck KgaA, Ipca Labs etc. at various levels right up to heading the Marketing & Sales function. From last 16 years, he is associated with IES Management College and has presented papers at various International & National conferences. His research work has been published in reputed International & National journals.

review_summary.college_name: Presidency College Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: During my time in the presidency, I had a lot of fun in college with my friends.

content.Placements: During my pass-out, the placements were happening, but there was no guarantee that you would be placed. If you had a back or anything, they didn't even consider your existence, and they just said that you were not eligible. In this way, I didn't like the placement department.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel is quite good, but better than other hostels I have seen. However, the infrastructure could be better because the college campus is too small for the students, with around 3000 to 4000 students. Attending courses would be very helpful in your life, and they have extracurricular activities that will boost you.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: It is one of the best colleges in Bangalore in terms of studies.

content.Placements: In our college, the placement rate of BCA is 95%, and almost all students get offers from various companies. The highest package offered in BCA is 14 LPA. The average package is 4.5 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Amazon, Deloitte, Accenture, TCS, Wipro, SAP, etc. The college puts pressure on 3rd year for the internship. We have a special subject about internships in which we have to submit our overall analysis of our work and experience. Roles offered are many as BCA is a technical course so we can get many job roles.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college, labs, and classrooms are fully well-furnished. Our college has 10 computer labs and 2 libraries with Wi-Fi support. Classrooms are fully ventilated. The hostel is average but the quality of food is good. Sports facilities are awesome.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: The best college from my experience in Bangalore.

content.Placements: I did my internship at PSU. I didn't get any stipend, but the learning was immense. I got a gist of how an organization functions and what it takes to market its products in rural and urban areas. The placement department provided opportunities and news about various companies to students through email. Interested students could proceed with the information provided by mail. The top companies that visited the campus for placements were Wipro, TCS, Birla, KPMG, Amazon, Airtel, Jio, SAP, etc. The roles offered were sales manager, data analyst, HR, etc. The percentage of students who got placed was 70%–80%.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Presidency College is a value for money.

content.Placements: Presidency College Bangalore has 100% placement as of 2023–24. The lowest package is 3.5 LPA, and the highest package is 14 LPA, with an average of 6 LPA. The top recruiters include KPMG, Deloitte, Accenture, HDFC Bank, and other companies. The maximum number of placements are in the field of marketing.
content.Infrastructure: The college has good facilities to support education. It has a wide library flourished on two floors. The college has a good canteen facility for refreshments and also has Wi-Fi facility on campus.
content.Faculty: The quality of faculty, experience, and the curriculum provided is very good and supportive to students. Faculty members are very supportive and knowledgeable, and they also provide students with valuable insights. The support provided by the L&D department in preparing students for interviews is appreciable.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied with the college because of the faculty members.

content.Placements: The role offered is financial analyst. The average package is 3 LPA to 12 LPA. The college gives us access to multiple companies such as Diageo, Axis Bank, Accenture, and many other companies. Our placement department always tries to give us the best package.
content.Infrastructure: The classes are well-equipped with Wi-Fi, AC, and projectors. The libraries consist of all kinds of study materials. The staff is also always helpful and they assist you with the right materials. The quality of food is moderate quality where you get good cheap food regularly. It is available for all the students at a very minimal price.

paragraphs: Presidency College admission processis a multi-step procedure, including online registration, release of the cutoff list, counselling, and seat allotment. Candidates should carefully go through the course-specific eligibility and selection procedure. For the candidate's reference, the step-by-step admission criteria is explained below:
STEP 1: Presidency College Application Process 2025

Presidency College course admissions commence with online registrations. Eligible students can apply through the college's official website. For registration, candidates need to provide some basic details and generate login credentials. Further, the application form should be submitted on or before the deadline.
STEP 2: Shortlisting of Students or Release of Cutoff List

For the UG courses, candidates are selected based on merit in the last qualifying exam followed by a telephonic round and interview. However, Presidency College PG admissions are entrance-based. The accepted entrance exams are KMAT/Karnataka PGCET. A cutoff list is released to declare the minimum score required for admission.
STEP 3: Seat Allotment & Admission Confirmation

After the release of thePresidency College cutofflist, candidates applying through state-level exams for MBA and MCA courses have to go through their respective counselling procedures to get a seat. For UG courses, shortlisted students can visit the college campus for document verification. In the final step, aspirants need to pay the required fee amount to confirm their seat.

Presidency College Hebbal feeis inclusive of multiple components such as tuition fee, hostel fee, caution fee, etc. The caution fee is a refundable component. reviews.review_heading: During my time in the presidency, I had a lot of fun in college with my friends.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is quite good, but better than other hostels I have seen. However, the infrastructure could be better because the college campus is too small for the students, with around 3000 to 4000 students. Attending courses would be very helpful in your life, and they have extracurricular activities that will boost you.

reviews.review_heading: It is one of the best colleges in Bangalore in terms of studies.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college, labs, and classrooms are fully well-furnished. Our college has 10 computer labs and 2 libraries with Wi-Fi support. Classrooms are fully ventilated. The hostel is average but the quality of food is good. Sports facilities are awesome.

reviews.review_heading: The best college from my experience in Bangalore.
reviews.review_text: The hostel staff was very kind and cooperative. The food provided was excellent and hygienic, with both non-veg and veg options. The hostel as per facilities, was worth the expenses. I was very satisfied with the hostel facilities and chose to be in the hostel instead of choosing a PG nearby.

reviews.review_heading: Presidency College is a value for money.
reviews.review_text: The college has good facilities to support education. It has a wide library flourished on two floors. The college has a good canteen facility for refreshments and also has Wi-Fi facility on campus.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the college because of the faculty members.
reviews.review_text: The classes are well-equipped with Wi-Fi, AC, and projectors. The libraries consist of all kinds of study materials. The staff is also always helpful and they assist you with the right materials. The quality of food is moderate quality where you get good cheap food regularly. It is available for all the students at a very minimal price.

reviews.review_heading: Good college with the best faculty members and good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The best infrastructure and a good hostel with a food facility are provided. They have used the new infrastructure facility in our college. We have a computer lab which is equipped with new computers and Wi-Fi in the college. There are the best computer applications.

reviews.review_heading: A genuine review of my college.
reviews.review_text: I don't stay in the college hostel as I prefer PGs are good but as far as I came to know about the college hostel, it is good. They provide good quality food. The hostel wardens are good. Even the college hostel is not that far from the college. It is nearby only.

reviews.review_heading: Life In Presidency Of A Student.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are good, like labs and classrooms, which are well updated to current technology, and we do have a good library. We also got sports and a canteen in our college, which is quite decent, and they are upgrading it to a big one. The hostel is also good, in neat condition.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it is the best college for MBA course.
reviews.review_text: More than 3,000 students might be accommodated in the hostels on site. For a monthly charge of Rs. 2,000, students could stay in ten dormitory structures. There is a mess in every dormitory where students could get food. It was a good-quality dish. The menu is rotating and is never changed.

reviews.review_heading: Really an average college; takes the *** out of you if attendance is less.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good. Never really tried the food from the mess and canteen. Sports and games are not okay. Attendance is the worst part of this college. Kalopsia happens every 4 years, which is kind of exciting. Additionally, they don't give you holidays during festivals too.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely Satisfied with Presidency College.
reviews.review_text: The campus has Wi-Fi, 3-4 labs, AC, a library, basketball and football grounds, a seminar hall, an auditorium, and a dedicated parking area for students. Hostel facilities and the mess food quality are nice; I would rate the mess food 4/5. The canteen food is outstanding, deserving 5/5. Medical facilities and sports amenities are also provided.

reviews.review_heading: Not good for placement. MCA students’ companies are very few, so it will.
reviews.review_text:
Classrooms are small, but they are good and clean. Wi-Fi was not good. Labs have fewer computers, which are better.
The library is large and nice.
The hostel food is amazing but very expensive. The food available in the canteen is mediocre. The medical facilities are non-existent. Sports and games are well-organized.

reviews.review_heading: Overall best college for MBA course.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of Presidency College is one of the best things you can see in the city. Although not a spacious campus, the overall layout of the building is decent. Classrooms are equipped with high-quality equipment such as projector screens and presentation platforms. Overall, the room is very clean and spacious enough to accommodate all of her classes.

reviews.review_heading: College has a good play area where students can enjoy.
reviews.review_text: Fests go on with many influencers, actors, singers, dancers, and models. The faculty organizes these events so that the students can enjoy, and it takes more than a month for the preparation of the fests. The library is filled with knowledgeable books, and we can take part in Kaun Banega Crorepati.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with good faculty, infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Facilities like smart boards, projectors, Wi-Fi, labs, library, and air-conditioned classrooms are available. The quality of hostel and canteen food is good. The college conducts many sports activities, both indoor and outdoor, in the DSA. They also offer free dance and yoga classes for students.

review_summary.college_name: Integral University Lucknow Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: I am dissatisfied with the faculty and also with the university system.

content.Placements: If we talk about placements, then we can't get anything from college. We can't even get anything with the help of faculty members. We have to do everything on our own. We have to make many efforts to secure a placement or take a job because the placement rate is only on paper, and there's nothing like getting a good placement and a good job with 30 or 40 LPA in BCA at Integral University. After admission, they say only one thing, that it's our own responsibility to get a job, and they can't do anything if we are an average student.
content.Infrastructure: We do not get any facilities for 1.5 lakhs, as it's the charge for 1 year of stay in the hostel. The hostel does not have AC. We don't get a single almirah or single B.Ed or anything else. It does not have a Wi-Fi system. There is no mess system included in it, and we have to give extra charges for the mess system. We don't have access to go out or in anytime we want. The room area is full of dust, or we can say the paint on the walls is very old. It has scratches. There is no single cleaner in the hostel building.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: The college gave good placements.

content.Placements: The placement of our university is very good. There are many companies that recruit students from our university at the best package prices. The top companies' names are Flipkart, HCL, Teach, Amazon, Mahindra, and many other companies like Paytm and Google Pay.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities of labs and classrooms are good, and the Wi-Fi network is also very good. The library is not very good, the facilities of the hostel are quite bad, and the food in the hostel is also poor. The ground is very good at our university, and many sports are played there.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Amazing, and most of the students are satisfied with the infrastructure and facilities.

content.Placements: In the last 4–5 years, in my course, the percentage of students who got placed is 67 percent. The highest package is 12 LPA, the average is 7 LPA, and the lowest is 3 LPA. The companies are Tata, Google, Flipkart, Sierra, and Techno. At least 12–15 students got placed in Flipkart, and some in Tata.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel infrastructure is great, with privacy and security at their best. The food in the hostel is hygienic and tasty. They have a very dynamic schedule for dinner, lunch, and breakfast, and they also provide snacks every evening around 5 pm. The rooms are well cleaned and have good bed quality. They also provide medical facilities and a sports complex.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Biotechnology - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Overall, the university is excellent. Faculty members are good, but the placement rate is low.

content.Placements: The average package is about 2.5–3 LPA. Companies visit, but not very frequently. Overall, the placement rate is good compared to other universities in Lucknow. However, if you only want placement, you should consider a university other than Integral University.
content.Infrastructure: My course is B.Sc. Biotechnology, and its fee is Rs. 90,000 per year. Hostel fees are separate and vary according to the type of room you choose. Mainly, two kinds of rooms are available here. They are AC and non-AC. The rooms are triple-sharing. Classrooms are well-equipped with projectors, microphones, and speakers.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: If you are serious about your studies, then you can study here otherwise, you cannot.

content.Placements: In my knowledge, only 10 to 15% get the placement. The highest placement of 2024 is 34 LPA. Top recruiting company in this college is TCS. Many students get paid internships, only 10 to 15% and the remaining 50% are unpaid. Top roles offered in our course are Software Engineer.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available in the labs, and AC is also available. Every classroom department has its library, and there is a Central library where you can study. The quality of the hostel is very good. Food is average, and the mess is there. All medical facilities, sports, and games are also available.

1. Integral University Application

Candidates applying for admission to courses offered at Integral University are required tofill application form either in online or offline mode. Candidates have to fill the form with basic details such as personal and educational information. Along with that, they also have to submit the relevant documents and pay an application fee before submitting the form.
2. Selection Rounds

For the selection of eligible applicants, the university accepts scores of various state national-level entrance exams. Candidates can also appear for theIUET exam, which is conducted by the university itself. The aspirants must qualify for any one of the entrance exams to qualify the Integral University selection process.
3. Final Admission

After the completion of all selection rounds, candidates will be evaluated based on their past academic scores and scores of the respective entrance exams. Later on, the university will release the merit list of the selected candidates. Candidates whose names appeared on the merit list must pay acertain amount of feeto confirm their seats.

reviews.review_heading: I am dissatisfied with the faculty and also with the university system.
reviews.review_text: We do not get any facilities for 1.5 lakhs, as it's the charge for 1 year of stay in the hostel. The hostel does not have AC. We don't get a single almirah or single B.Ed or anything else. It does not have a Wi-Fi system. There is no mess system included in it, and we have to give extra charges for the mess system. We don't have access to go out or in anytime we want. The room area is full of dust, or we can say the paint on the walls is very old. It has scratches. There is no single cleaner in ...

reviews.review_heading: The college gave good placements.
reviews.review_text: The facilities of labs and classrooms are good, and the Wi-Fi network is also very good. The library is not very good, the facilities of the hostel are quite bad, and the food in the hostel is also poor. The ground is very good at our university, and many sports are played there.

reviews.review_heading: Amazing, and most of the students are satisfied with the infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The hostel infrastructure is great, with privacy and security at their best. The food in the hostel is hygienic and tasty. They have a very dynamic schedule for dinner, lunch, and breakfast, and they also provide snacks every evening around 5 pm. The rooms are well cleaned and have good bed quality. They also provide medical facilities and a sports complex.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the university is excellent. Faculty members are good, but the placement rate is low.
reviews.review_text: My course is B.Sc. Biotechnology, and its fee is Rs. 90,000 per year. Hostel fees are separate and vary according to the type of room you choose. Mainly, two kinds of rooms are available here. They are AC and non-AC. The rooms are triple-sharing. Classrooms are well-equipped with projectors, microphones, and speakers.

reviews.review_heading: If you are serious about your studies, then you can study here otherwise, you cannot.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available in the labs, and AC is also available. Every classroom department has its library, and there is a Central library where you can study. The quality of the hostel is very good. Food is average, and the mess is there. All medical facilities, sports, and games are also available.

reviews.review_heading: The teachers are very helpful and help with students' careers.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available for the course are great, including internet connection, different kinds of labs, smart classrooms, and a library. The quality of facilities is good in the hostel, the mess, and the canteen. Medical facilities have improved, and games are conducted regularly.

reviews.review_heading: Now the teachers are very good, and they help in students' career building.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure were good. We had strong Wi-Fi connection and different kinds of labs, digital classroom, and library. The quality of facilities in hostel was hygienic, and provided 3 times meals. All meds were available in the medical room. There was a small playground in the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Earlier faculty never focused on students that's why students can't get good placed.
reviews.review_text: The best quality of infrastructure available like good internet Wi-Fi speed, smart classroom, and different kinds of library were there. Facilities available in hostel were fully air-conditioned bedroom and good quality food. Medical facilities were good enough, and mini field was there for playing games.

reviews.review_heading: A good university with a good atmosphere, nothing is over the board as I have seen at other colleges
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and hostel are good, with the constant change and upgrades going on, they are improving it, and its getting better through my 4 years. I have seen great investment in infrastructure, which helps a lot as a student, and it feels good.

reviews.review_heading: Now the faculty is old-fashioned.

One of the best quality food served in the hostel, better canteen hygiene is good, air-conditioned bedrooms, a medical room available, and a big ground for the students.

reviews.review_heading: A good and lovely college.

paragraphs: Lingaya’s Vidyapeeth has a placement cell that offers placement assistance to all of its students. Resume writing workshops, GD sessions, mock interviews, and other skill-building workshops are organized to train and enlighten students in numerous domains and also to develop their soft skills.

Recently, the institute has concluded the placements for the batch that passed out in 2025. As per the latest report, the highest package offered during Lingaya’s Vidyapeeth placements 2025 stood at INR 15 LPA . A total of 1100 students participated in the placement session 2025, of which 650 students were placed in reputed companies. reviews.review_heading: The best colleges in NCR. If you want the best infrastructure, this college is very good for you.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of the college is very nice, like a dream college. They have aesthetic views and provide nice facilities to their students. They have an AC classroom, nice branches, brand corners for the cafeteria. Along with an advanced library, and a big auditorium for students.

reviews.review_heading: College is very good, the campus is quite big, and the faculty are supportive.
reviews.review_text: Hostel is quite big, good and clean, and cold water is available, and rooms have wardrobes and beds of good quality. Also, the electricity is available all the time. Warden is also very supportive.

reviews.review_heading: Very satisfied, it gives us good placement, infrastructure, and the faculty is good.
reviews.review_text: Everything is good, whether it is infrastructure, classroom, hostel room, Wi-Fi, or lab everything is good, the quality of hostel rooms is very good, they are spacious and always clean. Food is good, medical facilities are good, and all sports games are played both in the college campus and outside the campus for competitions..

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides all types of support to the students.
reviews.review_text: We do have a lab with proper managing staff and a lab attendant. We do have smart boards in our classes and a separate departmental library in our pharmacy department. The hostels are in very good condition, and the wardens of both hostels are very supportive and treat all the students as their own children.

reviews.review_heading: Our college Infrastructure and water facilities are good.
reviews.review_text: Labs are well-equipped, neat, and have good facilities. Infrastructure is also good, clean, and full of ventilation with A.C., fans, and windows. A digital library is also available for some books. Wi-Fi is available in each department and hostel for students and teachers.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with this college because of good faculty, placement, and really good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Lingaya’s Vidyapeeth is a very good college, and the facilities and infrastructure of the college are very good. The college contains various departments like Pharmacy, Law, Nursing, etc. The classes are also very good, the labs are smart, and the library is very good.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is very time-restricted, students are not allowed to go outside the college before 3 pm.
reviews.review_text: Labs are well-equipped, neat, and have good facilities. Infrastructure is also good, clean, and full of ventilation with AC, fans, and windows. A digital library is also available but only for some books. Wi-Fi is available in the hostel for students. Games and sports encourage students towards competition.

reviews.review_heading: I am happy to have gotten admission in Lingaya’s Vidyapeeth.
reviews.review_text: Our B.Pharma department has fully equipped labs, smart classrooms, high-speed Wi-Fi, and a rich library, hostel facilities are clean, with good food in the mess and canteen. Medical support, sports, and games are well-maintained and easily accessible. I am very happy.

reviews.review_heading: Lingaya's Vidyapeeth review.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure for both the college and the hostel is living worthy. Cleaning is done according to the timetable regularly by the cleaning staff. A little development at some what part may be needed, but overall, the building, rooms, classes, and whole infrastructure are above average.

reviews.review_heading: College is great. The faculty are nice.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure and facilities are nice and good. Labs are always available for students. Labs are in good condition, and all the instruments, chemicals and glassware are available for students. Chemicals are of good quality and condition, and the instruments are of good quality.

reviews.review_heading: Good college for all the students.
reviews.review_text:
Wi-Fi is not available. State scholarship is not available in this college. 
Labs are good. Classroom is not very good. No AC in any classroom, 
if there is any, they will not be working. Teachers are very supportive and helpful, especially the sports teacher. The ground is very good. Academic activity is regularly done. Good senior behaviour.

reviews.review_heading: Best college in Faridabad.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure of the college and each department of education are the best at their level, as they are properly ventilated and built. The facilities in the hostel and mess are also nice, and the quality of food served in the canteen is also good.

reviews.review_heading: The best college I found for my higher studies.
reviews.review_text: The first thing I loved in my college was the infrastructure. The buildings and the green around the college are so good. Infrastructure is so amazing, I love my college, it was so good I can see my future bright. A blessed teacher, the best mentor to support.

reviews.review_heading: College is an okay environment, okay crowd. Here, it's not good, but the facility is nice.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is not so good. There are no ACs in the classroom. The lab seating arrangement is not good. The class is so crowded that I wanted to change the seating arrangement, and also the classroom cleanliness. The seats are so comfortable, and kindly look into this problem, there is no Wi-Fi in the classroom or lab.

reviews.review_heading: It's good for only the pharmacy in Faridabad under a good budget, but not for other courses.
reviews.review_text: Very old buildings and bad flooring, ceiling and wall materials. Titles are getting broken at many places in college. Also, a few water coolers are working, others are in the worst condition. AC doesn't work either, only in the Offices of the facility. Don't get fooled by AC at exception.

reviews_list.review_title: Change the approach towards education.

review_content.Placements: There is such a low percentage of placements. Out of 750 students, only 100–120 get placed, with most jobs offered by TCS. The highest package is 9 LPA offered by TCS, and the lowest is 2 LPA offered by Cognizant. Internships are mostly namesake, provided by training institutions rather than legitimate companies. The top internship is offered to only one student by Texas Instruments, with a stipend of Rs. 45,000 per month.
review_content.Infrastructure: Labs are very old-school not much quality and upgrades. Equipment is transferred from here to there. I understand that some old tools are necessary for learning basics, but completely driving into them alone is the route to irrelevant. The hostel food is decent, and rooms are also very mid-level. The canteen is managed by a private family and is very much better for that price. The medical facilities are well. Sports are a hit or miss, while good training and coaching are provided, but for normal students to try their luck there is not much encouragement. Wi-Fi facility is bad.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: A brief review of JNNCE, Shimoga.

review_content.Placements: After the 6th semester, students are eligible to participate in placements. More than 60% of students get placed. Most startups come for hiring. Every year, TCS conducts mass hiring, in which they hire students in bulk. Students from technical branches get placed more.
review_content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure-wise, college is good. Every branch has its building and separate labs. The campus is large and full of greenery. A cricket ground, throwball court, and indoor game facilities are present. The canteen is also present inside campus.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Electronics and Telecommunication, our branch, is very straightforward and clear, so it depends.

review_content.Placements: It depends on the department they are studying in. In my department, as I've observed, the strength was around 60+, and among them, 15-16 members got their placements. The highest package was from TCS at 12 LPA, some received 6 LPA, and the lowest was around 2.4 LPA. Almost 40-50 percent of the students got their placements. Top roles included field engineer, team leads, etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure available in our department are good. All equipment, including technical equipment for the lab, is well-organized, in good condition, and works efficiently. There are minimal errors while conducting experiments with the lab equipment. There are enough computers for students to use, and the library is very spacious and large, with the capacity to accommodate 100-150 students at once. We have an in-college canteen, which is a bit overpriced these days, but the food is good.

overview_faqs.question: Is JNNCE - Jawaharlal Nehru National College of Engineering a good college/Institute?
overview_faqs.answer: JNNCE - Jawaharlal Nehru National College of Engineering is a well-known institution for B.E. / B.Tech, M.E./M.Tech, MBA/PGDM, MCA courses. These programs are delivered by highly experienced faculty. As per Shiksha's verified reviews, JNNCE - Jawaharlal Nehru National College of Engineering has a rating of 3.81 on the basis of Shiksha-verified reviews by students. Not just this, it has also been rated 4.18 on Campus Life, 3.1 on Placements, 3.97 on Faculty and 3.98 on Infrastructure.

review_summary.college_name: JNNCE Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Very nice courses with better placements.

content.Placements: Most of the students are placed in better companies which help them to build their career. The students are placed in roles like data scientist, full-stack web developer, programmatic AI program, front-end developer, back-end developer, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has very good infrastructure with high-speed internet connection. It has proper labs with the latest technology equipment. Classrooms are very well maintained which helps for interactive sessions for the better understanding of the classes which helps us to concentrate.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: It's a good college for placements.

content.Placements: As a developer, software engineer, and associate engineer, many positions were offered by the college. Non-teaching roles were also provided in this college, which was a great experience. The percentage of students was 60%. The highest package offered was 10 LPA, and the lowest was 2.5 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The food, canteen, games, and sports were the best. In college, we had labs for practice, classrooms, a library, and a doubt section. Many facilities were provided by the college to students. In the hostel, the food quality was very good and very hygienic. The hostel was well maintained and good.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Change the approach towards education.

content.Placements: There is such a low percentage of placements. Out of 750 students, only 100–120 get placed, with most jobs offered by TCS. The highest package is 9 LPA offered by TCS, and the lowest is 2 LPA offered by Cognizant. Internships are mostly namesake, provided by training institutions rather than legitimate companies. The top internship is offered to only one student by Texas Instruments, with a stipend of Rs. 45,000 per month.
content.Infrastructure: Labs are very old-school not much quality and upgrades. Equipment is transferred from here to there. I understand that some old tools are necessary for learning basics, but completely driving into them alone is the route to irrelevant. The hostel food is decent, and rooms are also very mid-level. The canteen is managed by a private family and is very much better for that price. The medical facilities are well. Sports are a hit or miss, while good training and coaching are provided, but for normal students to try their luck there is not much encouragement. Wi-Fi facility is bad.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: A brief review of JNNCE, Shimoga.

content.Placements: After the 6th semester, students are eligible to participate in placements. More than 60% of students get placed. Most startups come for hiring. Every year, TCS conducts mass hiring, in which they hire students in bulk. Students from technical branches get placed more.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure-wise, college is good. Every branch has its building and separate labs. The campus is large and full of greenery. A cricket ground, throwball court, and indoor game facilities are present. The canteen is also present inside campus.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Electronics and Telecommunication, our branch, is very straightforward and clear, so it depends.

content.Placements: It depends on the department they are studying in. In my department, as I've observed, the strength was around 60+, and among them, 15-16 members got their placements. The highest package was from TCS at 12 LPA, some received 6 LPA, and the lowest was around 2.4 LPA. Almost 40-50 percent of the students got their placements. Top roles included field engineer, team leads, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure available in our department are good. All equipment, including technical equipment for the lab, is well-organized, in good condition, and works efficiently. There are minimal errors while conducting experiments with the lab equipment. There are enough computers for students to use, and the library is very spacious and large, with the capacity to accommodate 100-150 students at once. We have an in-college canteen, which is a bit overpriced these days, but the food is good.

review_content.Other: I was really inspired by the teachers in my college, they have experienced and well-talented tutors in the college. Library and labs are good enough. They maintain strict discipline and obedience inside the campus. My friends too got placed in many good IT sectors. paragraphs: SVPISTM Coimbatore admissionsare entrance-based. The institute accepts CUET-UG and CUET-PG scores for admission to specific courses. SVPISTM also take an entrance test-SVPET for admission to UG and PG courses.Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel International School of Textiles and Managementgives courses at UG and PG levels in distinct streams such as Management, Commerce, Science, etc. Interested candidates can apply online for their preferred course.

SVPISTM offers UG and PG courses in full-time mode. Candidates need to meet course-specific eligibility criteria to apply for a course. Below areSVPISTM coursesalong with their eligibility and selection criteria:
Download:SVPISTM Prospectus 2025,SVPISTM Brochure 2025

SVPISTM offers admission to courses based on national or university-level entrance exams. Candidates need to fulfil both eligibility and selection requirements to get admission. Below are the steps to get a seat in SVPISTM:
STEP 1: SVPISTM Application Process 2025

The mode of application is online. Aspirants can download and fill the form available on the institute website. Candidates need to pay an application fee of INR 500 to register for a course. Candidates belonging to SC/ ST/ PWD category are exempted from paying the application fee.
STEP 2: Selection

The institute conducts SVPET for shortlisting candidates for UG and PG admission. SVP Entrance Test is an online test conducted for one-hour duration. The test includes 50 MCQs for both UG and PG courses. Aspirants can also get admission to UG and PG courses based on CUET-UG and CUET-PG scores, respectively.
STEP 3: Admission Confirmation
Once the candidates are selected, they need to submit the specified documents for verification. They need to pay a course fee to confirm their seat in the institute.

reviews.review_heading: It is an underrated central government college.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides us with all the facilities. We have labs for textile chemical processing, textile testing, technical textile, weaving, knitting, garment construction, and stitching. The hostel facility is available for girls. The food served in the hostel is average.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel International School of Textiles and Management.
reviews.review_text: There is no hostel for boys, and our campus is not Wi-Fi-enabled. But the hostel has a Wi-Fi facility. Laboratory does not have any modern machinery. Library and classrooms are well-maintained. Mess and canteen facilities are better. Sports and games are not good in our college.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure, friendly faculty, lenient and average placements.
reviews.review_text: Our college is a Wi-Fi campus and we have computer labs and textile labs are emerging but college doesn't give importance to sports and games. Equipped with 24 hrs wifi facility throughout the college.

The quality of the food is good.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely the best college in India.

admission_process.title: The Oxford College of Engineering Admission Process

paragraphs: The Oxford College of Engineering admissions areentrance-based. The applications are ongoing for The Oxford College of Engineering admission 2024. Candidates can apply for various UG & PG courses, includingB.E., MTech, MBA and MCA. Admission to these courses is entirely entrance-based. The college accepts scores of various state/national-level entrance exams such asKCET, PGCET, GATE, KMAT, CAT, etc. Students at TOCE are admitted through both the government Quota and the Management Quota. More details around The Oxford College of Engineering admission 2024 are defined in the article below.

The Oxford College of Engineeringoffers UG & PG courses in the stream of Management,Engineeringand Computer Applications. To secure a seat in these courses at The Oxford College of Engineering, candidates must fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria for the respective courses. Tabulated below are the detailed course-wise eligibility and selection criteria for The Oxford College of Engineering course admissions:

The Oxford College of Engineering admission process consists of multiple rounds. Candidates need to meet the basic eligibility requirements to participate in the selection process. The detailed step-by-step admission process for The Oxford College of Engineering admissions are as follows:
Step 1: Application Process

To apply for admission at TOCE, candidates must download the application form from the official website of the college. Next, the form must be submitted to the administrative office of the Oxford College of Engineering.
Step 2: Selection Rounds

All supported by industry-relevant software such as MATLAB and KEIL.

reviews.review_heading: Choose it at your own risk.

reviews.review_heading: Why you should join The Oxford College of Engineering!

The canteen is well maintained and has sufficient space to sit and eat. There are many sports, like football and basketball, for which college teams participate in university-level competitions.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, a decent college with a friendly faculty.
reviews.review_text: There are 2 total buildings dedicated for Engineering, the old building was built when the college was first inaugurated, and the new building is fairly new and was built recently. There are many libraries including a central library along with departmental libraries.

faqs.answer: Globsyn Business School provides MBA (Global) programme in collaboration with Malaysia University of Science and Technology (MUST), a member of AIU and established in partnership with MIT, USA. To apply for the MBA (Global) programme in Globsyn Business School, all applicants must fill in the application form, which can be found in the Admissions Page of Globsyn Business School's website.The applicants are then shortlisted based on their profiles. placement_data.title: Global Business School Placement Overview 2023
paragraphs: The placement process at Global Business School includes a comprehensive pre-placement training and skill development program for the students. To identify the areas of proficiency in Aptitude, English, Current News Awareness, and Reasoning, each student takes the SAT I during the first semester of pre-placement instruction. Based on their SAT scores and training needs, the students are given the SAT II and SAT III tests and pre-placement training. This procedure continues through the second and third semesters until the students are prepared to handle the various industry interview processes.

As per the latest report, Global Business School concluded the placement drive for the MBA batch passed out in 2023. The highest and average package offered during Global Business School placements in 2023 was INR 10.88 LPA and INR 4.76 LPA, respectively. A total of 47 recruiters visited the campus for placements, of which 39 offered the final placements to the MBA Class of 2023. The top recruiters of Global Business School in 2023 included Asian Paints, Berger Paints, Puma, Ultatech, MRF, ITC, ICICI Bank, HDFC Bank, Decathlon, Flipkart, Indiamart , etc.

Talking about sector-wise placements, BFSI emerged as the top recruiting sector of Global Business School in 2023 with 46% of students placed . The other sectors in which the students were placed during GBS placements in 2023 include E -Commerce, HR, Ed-Tech, FMCG, etc.

reviews_list.review_title: It was a good college for an M.Sc. in Psychology in India.

review_content.Placements: Compared to other years, our placement cell worked hard this year. This year's packages ranged from the lowest at 2 LPA to the highest at 4.2 LPA. Jobs related to marketing, sales, banking, and insurance were available through recruiters like Hitech, ICICI, and others.
review_content.Infrastructure: Our college's infrastructure was good. It offered amenities like Wi-Fi, a library, labs, a canteen, a ground floor, and more. About five or six computer laboratories were available. We had a stunning library with between 7,000 and 10,000 books. We had excellent study materials in our courses. Our classrooms were smart. Both the South canteen and the basement canteen provided students with high-quality meals. Hostel facilities were available at our college.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: Absolutely worth for money.

review_content.Placements: Likely more than 80% of the students were placed through the campus placement. The average high package was 8 LPA, and the lowest was 3 LPA. Top recruiting companies were Wipro, Infosys, Delta, and many more. Top roles were in accounts, HR, sales, software, etc. Mostly the B.Sc. students were placed a lot.
review_content.Infrastructure: Our college had good and best infrastructure, and well maintained like the toilets were maintained clean daily. Floor was neatly maintained and in view of Wi-Fi, students were given separate and faculty had separate Wi-Fi. Classrooms were big enough and free as seats were a lot. I was not a hostel student so I don't know much about hostels.

content.Placements: Compared to other years, our placement cell worked hard this year. This year's packages ranged from the lowest at 2 LPA to the highest at 4.2 LPA. Jobs related to marketing, sales, banking, and insurance were available through recruiters like Hitech, ICICI, and others.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: T. John Group of Institutions (autonomous) is a college we shouldn't underestimate by looks.

content.Placements: Currently, no such information is available as I am still in the 2nd year. But heard from seniors that placements are pretty average. Not much support is provided. The average package offered ranges from around 3-4 LPA. It's actually not that good. Rest it is our efforts.
content.Infrastructure: It has a pretty good infrastructure and the hostel facilities are awesome. Especially the girls' hostel is very calm with friendly surroundings. The food quality is good overall it shouldn't be different for our station candidates. Wi-Fi is not available but classrooms are good.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharma) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: I am absolutely not satisfied due to more pressure given by the Principal and staff members.

content.Placements: Only a few students get placed by themselves and not by any college recommendation. The lowest package is 1.25 LPA and the highest package is 3.25 LPA. The average package is 2.15 LPA. Top recruiting companies like Cipla, Narayana, etc., hire students. Only a few students get internships by themselves and on their own hard work.
content.Infrastructure: I have the worst Wi-Fi experience. Classrooms are not proper. Computer systems are assigned to use. There are 5 to 6 computer works that teachers use of them. The hostel is the worst place for students who have to use the same facilities as other places like school or college.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: My journey through AI&ML.

content.Placements: I am Nandini and I am doing my B.E. in artificial intelligence and mission learning at T. John College. Honestly, the course is pretty good if you are interested in AI and coding. The subjects are really interesting, especially when we get to work on real projects and understand how I actually work. In placement wise, around 60 to 70% of students in our batch got placed in companies like Infosys, Velcro, PCS, IBM, and few startup companies for placements. The average package is around 3 LPA, and the highest is little over 6 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The library is one of my favorite places. It's quite a lot of books, and D won the digital sector if you prefer reading on screens. Our department facility is quite supportive, especially if you ask doubts or what help with the project. Hostels are okay nothing too fancy but manageable. I share my room with two other girls. The rooms are decent in size and we have enough space to study and keep our stuff. The washrooms are clean most of the time depending on the hostel block and honestly how responsible.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharma) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Greenery with knowledge and wisdom.

content.Placements: Placements in high named companies such as Cipla, etc. Many got placed in high-rated good companies which helps them in building their future with more success. Many got settled in foreign countries with high played salary. Many have built in strong base in India.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are always clean. Bathrooms are maintained with sanity. Our environment is green due to which our mind is always calm. Canteen provides variety and hygienic food. Hostel facility is also good with tight security. Labs have advanced equipment. Library has many books to refer to.

individual_reviews.course: B.B.A. in TJC - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: I am absolutely satisfied because of good faculty members, placements, and infrastructure.

content.Placements: Around 50% of students are placed from the college side in our course, with an average package of 3 LPA. Recruiting companies that often visit our college are Wipro and Infosys. 60% of students receive internship opportunities. The top roles offered are junior analyst and HR executive.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms, library, placement training, transport, Wi-Fi, hostel, and canteen facilities are provided by the college. The food is good quality, with breakfast and dinner served in the hostel. Students excelling in sports and games are highly encouraged here.

Counselling Process:Students whose names appear on the merit list will be called for the counselling process. During counselling, students will be required to choose their preferred courses and submit the necessary documents for verification.
Seat Allotment and Fee Payment:After successful counselling, students must pay the requisite fee to confirm and secure their admission at T John College.

reviews.review_heading: T. John Group of Institutions (autonomous) is a college we shouldn't underestimate by looks.
reviews.review_text: It has a pretty good infrastructure and the hostel facilities are awesome. Especially the girls' hostel is very calm with friendly surroundings. The food quality is good overall it shouldn't be different for our station candidates. Wi-Fi is not available but classrooms are good.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely not satisfied due to more pressure given by the Principal and staff members.
reviews.review_text: I have the worst Wi-Fi experience. Classrooms are not proper. Computer systems are assigned to use. There are 5 to 6 computer works that teachers use of them. The hostel is the worst place for students who have to use the same facilities as other places like school or college.

reviews.review_heading: My journey through AI&ML.
reviews.review_text: The library is one of my favorite places. It's quite a lot of books, and D won the digital sector if you prefer reading on screens. Our department facility is quite supportive, especially if you ask doubts or what help with the project. Hostels are okay nothing too fancy but manageable. I share my room with two other girls. The rooms are decent in size and we have enough space to study and keep our stuff. The washrooms are clean most of the time depending on the hostel block and honestly how res...

reviews.review_heading: Greenery with knowledge and wisdom.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are always clean. Bathrooms are maintained with sanity. Our environment is green due to which our mind is always calm. Canteen provides variety and hygienic food. Hostel facility is also good with tight security. Labs have advanced equipment. Library has many books to refer to.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied because of good faculty members, placements, and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms, library, placement training, transport, Wi-Fi, hostel, and canteen facilities are provided by the college. The food is good quality, with breakfast and dinner served in the hostel. Students excelling in sports and games are highly encouraged here.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college with average placements, good infrastructure, a campus with basic facilities.
reviews.review_text: There is no Wi-Fi facility. They provide basic infrastructure facilities like clean water, smart boards, desks, lawn area, library, laboratories, etc. Classrooms are spacious and have digital boards with good ventilation. There is no girls' hostel on the campus. There is only a boys' hostel, which provides good food. There is a common canteen which provides hygienic food.

reviews.review_heading: The amusing yet unamusing batch.
reviews.review_text: I don’t stay at the hostel, but my batchmates do. It has a card given to students staying there for food, which has both veg and non-veg options. It is clean and has good security. It has a small, well-maintained gym, and it’s a boys' hostel on the campus. It is pretty nicely equipped and maintained.

reviews.review_heading: Review of T. John Group of Institutions.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is very eco-friendly and environment friendly. There are 8 different departments that include management studies, BHM, B.Com, BCA, pharmacy, technology, engineering, and nursing. There are facilities like Wi-Fi, computer labs, a library, and a cafeteria in our college which are useful for students when needed. There is a hostel facility for both boys and girls. The quality of the food provided in the mess is manageable. Sports events are conducted frequently in ...

reviews.review_heading: Happiness in T. John as a nursing student.
reviews.review_text: We have different labs for each subject with high facilities. And have one library that has more than 3000 books. Phones are not allowed on our college campus. We have sufficient classrooms. And in the hostel we do have our own hostel. We have 2 hostels with college affiliation. And my hostel was very nice and had a calm atmosphere. The ambience is very good. Every Sunday we have an outing from 7 am to 6 pm.

reviews.review_heading: Studies, sports, and NCC are good.
reviews.review_text: We have a library and labs for MBA and kitchen facilities for BHM and BCA computer labs and big playgrounds and water facilities, washrooms, cleanliness, etc. Hostel is provided for boys inside the college, and hostel for girls is provided outside the college. Medical facilities are not there, but sports and games and events are conducted, and we have a veg and non-veg canteen with a bakery for snacks and a xerox shop for printouts.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied because of plenty of unwanted rules. But good at teaching.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are available in this college but not up to par, but still, it's okay. Average lab facilities, adequate classes, decent library, etc. are there. The hostel is pretty decent, and the food is above average. Sports activities will be encouraged in the college depending on your performance.

reviews.review_heading: The college life was decent but there were no good placements.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is decent. Sports and games were pretty good. The college canteen provides good food and it was a pretty good experience. The labs were okay; there are many systems but they were lacking A/C. Classrooms were good with smart boards.

reviews.review_heading: A college introduction with experience of 3 years studying in the institutions.
reviews.review_text: The college is big enough, and the classes are spacious with good ventilation and made with multiple windows, accommodating around 100 students. The labs are well-equipped with the necessary requirements, and the college has a hostel for boys with a good mess that provides food at an affordable price.

reviews.review_heading: Reality check before you join.
reviews.review_text: The college has a very old infrastructure, and the washrooms are not well-equipped. The toilets have mugs. Drinking water facilities are available but without glasses. The classrooms are average, and Wi-Fi is not available. The library is good but filled with unwanted stuff.

reviews.review_heading: Prefer to get admission in Pharmacy.
reviews.review_text: The college boasts excellent facilities including well-equipped classrooms, projectors, a spacious lawn area, an auditorium, a library, a computer lab, a canteen, and a hostel serving high-quality food. The campus is adorned with lush greenery, maintained cleanliness, and state-of-the-art laboratories for hands-on learning experiences.

faqs.answer: Admission to MBA is based on CAT, CMAT or KMAT score. The shortlisted candidates are called for GDPI round. Candidates are given a topic of current relevance and are asked to present his/her views on the topic individually and in a group. The objective of GD is to test the knowledge, attitude, communication skills, leadership qualities, etc. of the participating candidates. After attending the group discussion, candidates need to appear for a personal interview with HR experts. The aptitude, attitude, managerial potential, etc. of the aspirants are assessed at this stage. On completion of the personal interview, a rank list is prepared based on the aggregate score attained by the candidate in the entrance test (80% weightage), group discussion (10% weightage), and interview (10% weightage).

paragraphs: Univesity Business School admission criteriais entrance-based. For admission, aspirants need to pass the PU-CET (PG) entrance exam, which is conducted by the university itself. For an MBA, a CAT exam score is also accepted. The process involves other selection rounds as well. Find below details about the complete process:
Step 1: UBS Chandigarh Application Process 2025

The B-School accept releases application form in online mode. Candidates can fill out the form and pay the application fees. A hard copy of the application has to be sent to the school along with the important documents. Candidates shall further ensure that they submit the application form on or before the deadline.
Step 2: Release of Merit List

Candidates are shortlisted for selection rounds based on their scores in the PU-CET (PG) exam and CAT (for MBA). Based on the applicant's score, a merit list is prepared and published on the B-School official website as well.
Step 4: Counselling cum Admission

After the final results are out, the selected candidates may have to visit the B-School campus. In the counselling cum admission process, candidates documents are verified, and group discussion and interviews are carried out. After these rounds, the selected candidates can pay the required fee amount to confirm their seat.

University Business School fees include multiple components such as tuition fees, hostel fees, and security deposit. Some of the components are one-time chargeable. The candidates have to make some fee payment at the time of admission and the rest can be paid semester-wise. The average package offered to students was INR 8.5 lakh. UBS Chandigarh, Panjab University seat allotment is done as per the guidelines of the Government of India and the University Grants Commission (UGC). placement_data.title: UBS Chandigarh Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: As per media reports, a total of 105 students have been placed till now during UBS Chandigarh placement 2025. The highest package offered in 2025 was INR 25 LPA . The average package received was INR 12.95 LPA . Further, the overall placement rate recorded was 85%.

There is a dedicated cell at the University that facilitates all types of UBS Chandigarh placement activities. According to the UBS Chandigarh admission brochure 2025, the highest and average package offered to MBA students in 2024 was INR 24 LPA and INR 12.43 LPA , respectively. Further, more than 45 recruiters visited the campus out of which 17 were new recruiters during UBS Chandigarh MBA placement 2024.

It is to note that the highest and average package decreased by 59% and 9%, respectively as compared with 2023. The top recruiters that visited UBS Chandigarh in 2024 included TCS, HSBC, DLF, Infosys and SBI .

reviews.review_heading: The best review about University Business School, Chandigarh.
reviews.review_text: The overall infrastructure is best. We get paid freight services, excellent computer labs, and smart lecture rooms. It has different types of blocks that have a separate unique identity. A unique style of infrastructure represents the courses and the environment.

reviews.review_heading: Good college with decent infrastructure and placement opportunities.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available on the campus are decent or average, I would say. It is enough according to the fees they are charging, and it is a government college. The facilities in the hostel are average too. You will get decent food in the mess and canteen, but the overall campus life is good as it is on the main Punjab University campus.

reviews.review_heading: Review of University Business School, Chandigarh, Panjab University.
reviews.review_text: Our college was equipped with a state-of-the-art computer laboratory with more than 50 terminals connected to high-speed internet connectivity through the computer center. Our campus was Wi-Fi-enabled. Air-conditioners were available in the auditorium. There were two seminar halls equipped with audio-visual aids and computers. Our college had an in-house library with more than 11,443 books and 152 journals comprising both Indian and International publications, thus enabling students to find refe...

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college under ROI segment.
reviews.review_text: It is a government institution, and it was built more than 50 years back, so it lacks good infrastructure. Maintenance is also low. Every student doesn't get a hostel, and it is allocated on merit basis as it comes under the university norms rather our college. There are no residential hostels.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the college as it provides good placements and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: It is a government-funded college.  Our department is furnished with all the facilities and also the infrastructure is too good. All lecture theatre and classrooms have air-conditioning along with projectors. This college has a hostel of Panjab University itself and the fee is just Rs. 1,000 per month. All the facilities such as the canteen, medical, sports and games are available.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides good ROI, but doesn't take many hopes.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure available is huge and good and it is the best thing in PU. Each department has its library and a common library of PU i.e. air-conditioned Joshi library. Hostels are also good concerning the amount of fee charged by them. The food served is good at a low price. There is a health center on the PU campus which is free for students of PU, stationery shops, sports facilities, and everything is very good. Wi-Fi is provided by every department to its student which works on the entir...

reviews.review_heading: The college is good and gives various opportunities in different fields to students.
reviews.review_text: The college provides a canteen, good infrastructure, sports clubs and cultural activity clubs for various activities. Hostel facilities are also good because cleanliness standards are satisfactorily met. Moreover, there are also good medical facilities in case of any emergency. There is Wi-Fi connectivity on the campus. Smart classes are under progress for better learning of students.

reviews.review_heading: Best ROI. Training & Placement Officer made personal efforts to get all the students placed.
reviews.review_text: We had all the available infrastructure in both our department/university and the hostel. We had free wi-fi in the entire campus, computer labs, the department library and a separate university library. We also had a digital library which could be accessed from the campus wi-fi supporting lakhs of research journals and books. The food was good. We also had the supply of milk and fresh juices of seasonal fruits throughout the year.

reviews.review_heading: It has a good return on investment but focuses on gaining economy.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is just fine as it is a government institute. However, every classroom has a projector and is air-conditioned. The campus has an amazing air-conditioned Joshi library, which is open for 24 hours. Girls hostels are well-equipped and are very clean. They include a gym, guest rooms, common room and study area. The campus has an amazing playground.

reviews.review_heading: Review of University Business School, Chandigarh - Panjab University.
reviews.review_text: In comparison to the fees they charged, the infrastructure of our college is good enough and well furnished. Facilities like Wi-Fi, computer labs and library are available. The best part is that students had access to the library for 24 hours. The college provides 8 boys hostel and 10 girls hostel on our campus. Allotment of hostels is done on merit basis.

reviews.review_heading: Review of University Business School.
reviews.review_text: The college is located inside the Panjab University Campus, so all the facilities provided inside the campus can be availed by UBS students as well. There are beautiful gardens and well-maintained sports grounds and courts. There is no separate hostel for UBS students, and the admissions into the hostels are purely merit-based.

reviews.review_heading: University Business School offers good placements at an affordable fee for MBA.
reviews.review_text: Our college has good hostels and good campus. Wi-Fi is available here, and the food is served at a low cost. Student centre offers affordable meals. There are many good joints nearby in Sector 15 right opposite to PU campus, where good food can be served at less price. The hostel mess charges Rs. 35-40 for a single meal and provides unlimited servings.

reviews.review_heading: Good placement with minimum fees.
reviews.review_text: Since it is a government college, one can't expect infra something like other B-day schools. Still it has maintained a decent infra with facilities like Wi-Fi for everyone, projector facility in every classroom, classrooms equipped with A. C, and library facility as well. Since it is not a residential programme, limited number of hostels room are available for students and given on as per their rank in merit list.

reviews.review_text: The hostel facility is provided by the college, where they are charging 60,000 per year. Though the hostel is quite far from the college, they are providing bus facility. The college is providing Wi-Fi in the hostel as well as in the college, and computer facilities are also provided by them.

reviews.review_heading: A university with great placement and quality of education.
reviews.review_text:
1. The facilities and infrastructure available in our college were very superior as compared to other colleges. It provides Wi-Fi, labs and classroom facilities along with a library inbuilt. 
2. The quality of facilities available in the hostel is good and talking about the food in the canteen, it was very healthy and delicious and college also provides medical and sports facilities apart from that.

reviews.review_heading: University with great learning and experiences.

1. The facilities and infrastructure available for our course/ department was great and it also provides Wi-Fi, labs and classroom facilities along with the library. 
2. The quality of the facilities of our hostel is well and good and it also has a canteen whose food is delicious and it also provides medical and sports facilities.

1. The facilities and infrastructure available for our course/department is nice and it also provides Wi-Fi, labs and classroom facilities.

reviews.review_heading: A college with great placement and teaching.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course are good, and it also provides Wi-Fi, labs, and classroom facilities. It also has a library inbuilt. The quality of the facilities of our hostel is very good, as it provides delicious food and also medical facilities.

reviews.review_heading: A university with great placement and learning.
reviews.review_text: The quality of the facilities and infrastructure available for our course is good. It provides labs, classrooms, and Wi-Fi facilities. The quality of the facilities in our hostel was good, and the food available in our canteen was also great. It also provides sports and medical facilities.

reviews.review_heading: The ICFAI University was a good university.
reviews.review_text: All facilities are there. The quality of food is okay. The hostel rooms are very clean; they change the bed sheet every day. The food is also good; they serve the food like you are at home, so you never miss your home. The staff are very friendly and helpful.

reviews.review_heading: Everything was good there!
reviews.review_text: Though I never had a chance to live in the hostel, I have heard good things about it. The Wi-Fi was good, making it easier to communicate. The library and classrooms were excellent, the food was good in the canteen, and the medical facilities and sports were good.

reviews.review_heading: Small campuses weigh out the good faculty.
reviews.review_text: The course I'm taking is B.A. LL.B., and the teachers there are very professional and absolutely top-notch! There's no doubt about the availability of basic infrastructure such as libraries, canteens, computer labs, and moot courts, albeit small, respectively. However, the only disappointment I have is with the campus because it is ridiculously small and it has completely altered my idea of college life. As I said, the teaching faculty is very good, but the satisfaction with the campus outweighs...

reviews.review_heading: Everything is fine, just the lack of an open academic field and aesthetics is needed here.
reviews.review_text: My college has almost all the facilities needed in student life. The facilities are top-notch in the university; just a lack of playing grounds makes it incomplete. The canteen offers the best food for the price of less, which is a profit if we see. The teachers here are so genuine and great helping hands for the students.

reviews.review_heading: I am both satisfied and dissatisfied because of the faculty members; there are no good placements.
reviews.review_text: We do not have anything like projectors to present in class; we had to go to another classroom to do our presentations. reviews_list.review_title: The college is really good. If one wants to do an MBA from Madhya Pradesh,it's a really good college

review_content.Placements: AFMR has achieved notable placement records over the last few years. In 2022-23, 82 students were placed, with the highest package reaching 13 Lacs, and the average between 4-7 Lacs. Top recruiters include TCS, Bajaj Finance, Flipkart, ICICI Bank, and Bandhan Bank.
