review_content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure of our college are very good. We have regular classes and many events. The canteen is also good. Food quality is also good, and proper hygiene is maintained. We don’t have hostel facilities, or maybe I am not aware of it. The college is far away from the city, so bus facilities are there.

reviews_list.batch_info: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2023
reviews_list.review_title: The students should once visit this college before pursuing MBA.

review_content.Placements: Around 50-60% of students are placed. The package which is offered to the students mainly depends on their performance, but also the highest salary package offered is 6 LPA. The lowest salary package offered is 2 LPA. The average salary package offered is 3.5 LPA. The top recruiting company is HDFC Bank. Almost 80-90% of students get internships from our course in reputed companies. The top roles offered in our course are digital marketing manager and business analyst.
review_content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure that are available for our department are Wi-Fi, laboratories, classrooms, and a library. All the facilities are very good and well arranged for the students. The hostel facilities for the students are not available in our department because our college is situated far away from the city, and bus facilities are very well arranged by the management. The food available in the mess and canteen are also very good, medical facilities are also very good. The girls have common rooms for the rest if they feel unwell at any time. Sports and games facilities are also good.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelors of Management Studies (BMS) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Our college has good faculty members and infrastructure.

content.Placements: Our college provides very good placements. Morningstar, ICICI Bank, Axis Bank, Byju's, etc., visit our college. The highest salary package offered is 7 LPA. The average salary package offered is 4 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: Our college provides the best infrastructure. It provides Wi-Fi. We have a spacious IT lab and a decent library. The library provides regular newspapers. It has various books. All classrooms are air-conditioned. The campus has a canteen. It provides great food.
content.Faculty: All teachers are very helpful, qualified, and experienced in their respective fields. They teach well. The course curriculum is relevant. It makes students industry-ready. The semester exams are decent. The pass percentage is good.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelors of Management Studies (BMS) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: My heart, my SRBS (BMS). Review

content.Placements: Almost 90% of students get placement. For HR 5-6 LAC per an um. For finance 10-12 Lac per annum, For marketing 4-5 Lac per annum in BMS. I don't that much but I do know there are tons of companies there is a list of all the companies on the 4th floor and tata is one of them. Faculty made a group for that also, faculty are on LinkedIn and they share tons of internships almost every day students choose an internship an intern. Manager, financial advisory, manager in recruiting team in a company, manager in adv agency etc.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure in our college is too good, too good all day Wi-Fi, carrom and table tennis for playing, and a library with 1000+ books. If we talk about facilities it's overboard, AC, cold purified drinking water etc. Canteen is a veg canteen and huge variety of dishes.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Management Studies (MMS) - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: I'm glad I had great faculty members teaching me to evolve as a good knowledgeable person.

content.Placements: Total Placement is around 70% . The Placement cell does help you provided you take regular follow ups. Majority of placements are in finance and marketing , so if you're opting for these specialization then 80% chances are that you will get a good placement. Whereas in case you're opting for HR and Operations specialization then mostly you have to struggle in finding a job on your own. Approximately 90% of students get help for searching internships irrespective of their specialization choices. But if you have caliber, college placements doesn't really matter, you can find job for yourself. Never rely on anybody to spoon feed you.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Management Studies (MMS) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: The best institute to shape your career, with qualified teachers that help you achieve your dreams.

content.Placements: The placement department of SRBS is very active and makes sure that maximum students get placed during their tenure. Recruitments for jobs and internships for all the specialisations are assured. Companies like Capgemini, Hindustan Unilever Limited, etc., are the top recruiting companies at SRBS.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of SRBS is highly advanced, with the finest quality of facilities available. Air-conditioned classrooms, a well-stocked library with a digital library, advanced computer labs, and a big auditorium that can accommodate around 350 people, come under the lavishly maintained infrastructure of SRBS.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Management Studies (MMS) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: I'm satisfied because of supportive faculty members, infrastructure and facilities provided here.

content.Placements: I am in my first year of MMS. In terms of placements, SRBS is good. Almost 90% to 95% of students got placements in good companies. They got a salary package of around 3.5 LPA to 4 LPA. All the students from our batch got internships in companies like Aditya Birla, Reliance Nippon and Meru Mobility.
content.Infrastructure: Overall, the facilities and infrastructure are good here. Our college provides Wi-Fi, classrooms with good ambience and air-conditioning system, library, computer lab, canteen and a common room for girls and boys. The main thing is that our college committee does not entertain misbehaviour and illicit activities.

individual_reviews.title: The college has good faculty, placements, infrastructure, and facilities.

content.Placements: About 80% of students get placed every year. A minimum package of 3.5 LPA and the highest 12 LPA by top recruiting companies like Solar Square, Jaguar, HDFC, etc. Top roles offered are in sales and marketing. About 90% of placements come from the college itself.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available, and smartboards are present in every classroom. Library facilities are available. The computer lab has all computers in working condition. Discussion rooms, water coolers, clean washrooms, a canteen, parking space, and common rooms for both girls and boys are available. Lift facilities are available in emergency conditions.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: They provide excellent education with placements.

content.Placements: From the third semester, students become eligible for campus selection. There will be nearly 15-20 companies visiting our college only for MBA students. Separate placement drives will be conducted for other branch students. Nearly 80% of the students will be placed in every academic year. Every student is eligible to apply for all the companies. The highest package of our academic year is 20 LPA. My plan after getting a degree is to pursue post-graduation.
content.Infrastructure: This college is only an MBA college, so it has a small but effective structure. Three-storey building where on the ground floor all administration and teaching staff offices are situated. On the 1st, the library; on the 2nd, class held for final year; and on the top floor, classes for 1st year with the IT lab.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: The NBA-accredited MBA program from DMIMS was a perfect fit for me and my profile.

content.Placements: After completion of your 2nd year, they provide you with free training through personalized training and placement agencies. In the middle of the 5th semester, the placement process starts. A maximum of 80-90% of students will be placed in reputed companies. Stella serves the best in terms of placements. The starting salary will be around 3 LPA with better roles.
content.Infrastructure: Seminars, workshops, and conferences were a regular thing in our college. We learned a lot during these extra sessions that were organized at least twice a month. From synergizing Human Capital Potential to a skit by Mumbai's Dabbawala, there were many informative turns during these events.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: Lots of events and lots of opportunities are provided by the college for extracurricular activities.

content.Placements: After the completion of the third year, various companies come to the college and offer us many opportunities, so we don't need to go out and search for jobs. By the end of the final year, 70% of the students get placed in various companies with really good packages and more opportunities as well.
content.Infrastructure: The college has a number of extracurricular activities, such as Women’s Day and the Ganpati festival, which provide insight into how we can celebrate it by going green, as well as Dahi Handi and many workshops. The college also provides free medical check-up camps for the faculty. These activities have boosted the morale of the college.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: One of the best college in Nagpur that provide excellent education with placement.

content.Placements: Students become eligible for campus placements from the fifth semester onwards. Many MNCs offered placements, and around 70% of the students were successfully placed through on-campus recruitment. There were also several internship opportunities available for students during their third and fourth semesters.
content.Infrastructure: This is an MBA-only college, so the campus is small but efficient. It consists of a three-story building. The ground floor houses all administrative offices and faculty rooms. reviews.review_heading: One good opportunity to grab.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the review of Sinhgad Business School.

reviews.review_heading: All about Sinhgad Business School.

There is a sports room on the campus which offers many indoor games such as carrom, table tennis, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Nice experience with the diversified people.

Syndicate room, seminar hall, and waiting area are centrally air-conditioned.

reviews.review_heading: Infrastructure and the faculty are good. The placements are okay. Overall, it is good.

There is less space to play the sports on the campus.

reviews.review_heading: Good management, experienced staff, good infrastructure.

There is no place to sit in the campus provided by the college, it is a very small campus.

reviews.review_heading: Best business school in Pune.

reviews.review_heading: My two years were simply awesome. I am very much satisfied because of faculty.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are good and almost everything is perfect. Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, library, medical facilities, sports and games, everything is there. Also, the college provides cultural events and sports events as well. I did not avail the service of a hostel so I cannot say anything. I was very happy during the time of my tenure at the college.

reviews.review_heading: Review of SBS - Sinhgad Business School.
reviews.review_text: The college provides good infrastructure. The quality of the classrooms can be improved. Air-conditioners are not working, and there is no lift for students. They have multiple floors building which students need to climb. The colleges' canteen is very boring, and they serve only Maggi. Wi-Fi facility available is every slow. Sports facilities are also not available. The library is also not updated with the latest book.

reviews.review_heading: The college maintains proper co-ordinations with students at any stage.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is very nice and provides a good study environment. All streams in the college have different floors to get a spacious place to explore. There are a library and computer labs where students have a good concentration on their studies.

reviews_list.batch_info: BBA(Hons.) in Global Marketing and Event Management - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Great College, possibly have a lot of money, but it has a very strict attendant policy.

review_content.Placements: As per what I have listened, around 40 percent of students got placements. The highest package is around 11 LPA. Companies from all over the world. Only 30 percent of the people got internships; the other 60 percent are doing their own business. Senior event manager to handle the companies’ events.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the syllabus and the course is very interesting, and we get to go to the rural areas for some days and a national study trip. I can’t tell you much about the hostel as I am not in MIT hostel, but as per what I have listened, the rooms are really good. Hostel food and its quality is not very promising. They have lots and lots of sports activities.

reviews_list.batch_info: BBA(Hons.) in International Business - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: It's a good college for anyone genuinely interested.

review_content.Placements: In my batch, around 55-60 percent of students are placed. The highest package offered is around 12 LPA-15 LPA. Common roles offered are business executive, relationship manager, and operations executive. Overall, opportunities exist, but the outcome depends heavily on internships and how we carry ourselves.
review_content.Infrastructure: The campus is neat and clean. There are clear rules mentioned, and actions are also taken against violators. I can't say anything about the food as I haven't tried it, but the vibe of the campus is top class, especially when it rains. The crowd is amazing too, and we will feel like coming to college every day.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Good college with balanced academics and campus life.

review_content.Placements: In my course, around 75 percent of students got placed, and the rest opted for higher studies outside India. The highest package offered is around 30 LPA, and the average is around 7 LPA. Top recruiters include Infosys, Microsoft, HCL, and Tech Mahindra. Top 5 percent of students got internships with a stipend, and in very good companies, the rest had to struggle for it.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is modern. Our department has well-equipped labs with Macs and high-speed Wi-Fi. Hostel facilities are decent, the mess food is manageable, not amazing, but edible. One girls' hostel is on the campus itself, but the only boys' hostel is around 8-9km away from the campus; however, the college provides bus facilities. Sports grounds, indoor games, and medical facilities are available in the new sports complex.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Cyber Security and Forensics) - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Strong cybersecurity programme with supportive faculty.

review_content.Placements: For the placement drive 2024, the CSE cybersecurity and forensics branch has around 120-130 students, out of which around 80 got placed, and the highest salary offered was 19 LPA, and the average package was around 7-8 LPA. Major companies included IBM, TCS, Accenture and HCL. Top roles mainly consisted of a Security analyst.
review_content.Infrastructure: The entire academic building and labs are covered with campus-wide Wi-Fi. In speak hours, it may slow a bit, but overall connectivity is reliable. Most CSE classes are conducted in newer academic blocks, so classrooms feel modern. The biggest library you'll find in Pune has various books from different streams available. Hostel rooms are not luxurious, but comfortable and functional. Mess Food is average to good, completely veg. MIT has 2 different canteens, one of the premium ones called Encave and the other, a budget-friendly one called Shreeraj.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: It is one of the best college.

review_content.Placements: This is my first year in college and I am not more aware of the placement. While taking admission in college my staff member told me the lowest is 3 LPA and the highest is 1.5Cr. I do not know exactly they told me this only. There are many cloud of internships in this college but they charge. Till now I have not done any internship but I saw many companies coming to college for internship programme like Tata etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: It has excellent infrastructure and it has availability of Wi-Fi labs classrooms and library. Library is to good for this college. I did not see any college that has this kind of library. Hostel canteen food is not that good. Sports and game facilities are good. It has a dark side also some students are addicted to drugs and do wrong things. 1 or 2 months ago there a child ordered something from Blinkit and some things happened that the Blinkit boy beat our campus student he was full of blood.

reviews_list.batch_info: Integrated M.Sc. in Biotechnology - Batch of 2030
reviews_list.review_title: The college has good infrastructure and plenty of clubs.

review_content.Placements: Seniors mentioned that most students from both technical and non-technical branches get placed successfully if they are consistent and make proper use of the training provided. College also organises workshops, mock interviews, and aptitude tests to help students improve their communication and problem-solving skills, which play a key role during recruitment.
review_content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is the best thing at MIT-WPU. Also, our (biotech students) building of work (maitre, Kashyap) has proper classrooms and labs. I don't know about the hostel as I don't live in a hostel, but some of my friends do. They have said food quality is not so good, also they have other facilities like washing machines and all provided, but still they don't like it much.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission to B.Tech at MIT-WPU Pune?
faqs.answer: For admission to the BTech course, MIT-WPU, Pune accepts scores of various state/ national-level entrance exams such as JEE Main/ MHT CET/ PERA CET/ MHT CET B/ NEET UG. Hence, candidates willing to get admission to the course must appear and qualify in any one of the accepted entrance exams. For some specialisations, students may have to write a Statement of Purpose (SOP).

faqs.question: How can I get direct admission in MIT-WPU?
faqs.answer: MIT-WPU Pune does not offer direct admission to its UG and PG courses. MIT-WPU course admissions for all courses are either done via MIT-WPU CET, which is conducted by the university itself. The university also accepts various state and national-level entrance exams such as PERA CET, JEE Main, CAT, MAT, NEET UG, etc. Those who want to get admission to any of the UG and PG courses at MIT-WPU, must fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria in the first place and then appear for the respective entrance exams. For some PG courses such as MBA and MCA, the university also accepts valid scores in personal interview rounds as part of their selection process. The final seat allotment is done based on the counselling rounds.

faqs.question: Can I do BCA from MIT Pune?
faqs.answer: To study a three-year BCA (Science) course at MIT Pune, candidates have to fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria as per the university norms. The minimum eligibility to apply for BCA at MIT Pune is to pass Class 12 in the Science stream or pass a Diploma in Engineering. Find below the complete eligibility criteria for MIT Pune BCA admissions:Class 12 with 50% aggregate in Science stream with English subject (45% aggregate in case of Backward class category candidate belonging to Maharashtra State only)Passed a 3-year Engineering Diploma with 55% aggregate from a Govt. approved institutionNote:Candidates need to fulfil any one of the ababove-mentionedligibility requirements.

faqs.question: Does MIT-WPU, Pune have an entrance exam for BBA?
faqs.answer: MIT-WPU Pune offers three and four-year BBA courses in the stream of Management. For MIT-WPU BBA admission, the university conducts an in-house entrance exam, i.e., MIT-WPU CET. This is a common entrance exam valid for admission to all UG courses. To appear for this entrance exam, aspirants are required to fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria and apply online for the entrance exam. It's mandatory for aspirants to qualify for MIT-WPU CET exam with a valid score and submit it at the time of filling the application form.

placement_data.title: MIT-WPU, Pune Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: MIT-WPU, Pune has released the placement details for the Class of 2025. More than 730 recruiters visited the campus for 2025 placements and selected 2455 students of the batch 2025. The overall highest package offered to the batch 2025 stood at INR 51.36 LPA , whereas the average salary offered was INR 6.23 LPA. The median salary offered to the batch 2025 was INR 5.50 LPA . The top recruiters of MIT-WPU, Pune in 2025 include Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Intel, Goldman Sachs, etc. Apart from securing the annual package, the students also received internship opportunities from the recuiters in 2025. The highest stipend offered was INR 80,000.

Earlier, the highest package offered during MIT-WPU, Pune placement 2024 stood at INR 51.36 LPA. A total 2,544 students registered, of which 1,903 were placed in leading companies. More than 600 companies visited the campus.
The students of the BDes batch 2023 secured the highest package of INR 20 LPA.

hostel.description:
MIT-WPU provides students with modern and comfortable hostel facilities, catering to diverse needs and interests. Equipped with amenities such as dance studios, gyms, basketball courts, and inviting common areas, the hostels offer a vibrant and engaging living environment. Students have the flexibility to choose between twin-sharing and triple-sharing rooms, each furnished with unlimited high-speed Wi-Fi and regular housekeeping services. 

The safety of students is a top priority, with full-time wardens, CCTV monitoring, and biometric-enabled entrances ensuring a secure living space. MIT-WPU's commitment to providing well-equipped and secure hostels reflects its dedication to creating a conducive and enriching residential experience for its students.

reviews.review_heading: Great College, possibly have a lot of money, but it has a very strict attendant policy.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the syllabus and the course is very interesting, and we get to go to the rural areas for some days and a national study trip. I can’t tell you much about the hostel as I am not in MIT hostel, but as per what I have listened, the rooms are really good. Hostel food and its quality is not very promising. They have lots and lots of sports activities.

reviews.review_heading: It's a good college for anyone genuinely interested.
reviews.review_text: The campus is neat and clean. There are clear rules mentioned, and actions are also taken against violators. I can't say anything about the food as I haven't tried it, but the vibe of the campus is top class, especially when it rains. The crowd is amazing too, and we will feel like coming to college every day.

reviews.review_heading: Good college with balanced academics and campus life.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is modern. Our department has well-equipped labs with Macs and high-speed Wi-Fi. Hostel facilities are decent, the mess food is manageable, not amazing, but edible. One girls' hostel is on the campus itself, but the only boys' hostel is around 8-9km away from the campus; however, the college provides bus facilities. Sports grounds, indoor games, and medical facilities are available in the new sports complex.

reviews.review_heading: Strong cybersecurity programme with supportive faculty.
reviews.review_text: The entire academic building and labs are covered with campus-wide Wi-Fi. In speak hours, it may slow a bit, but overall connectivity is reliable. Most CSE classes are conducted in newer academic blocks, so classrooms feel modern. The biggest library you'll find in Pune has various books from different streams available. Hostel rooms are not luxurious, but comfortable and functional. Mess Food is average to good, completely veg. MIT has 2 different canteens, one of the premium ones called Encave...

reviews.review_heading: It is one of the best college.
reviews.review_text: It has excellent infrastructure and it has availability of Wi-Fi labs classrooms and library. Library is to good for this college. I did not see any college that has this kind of library.  Hostel canteen food is not that good. Sports and game facilities are good. It has a dark side also some students are addicted to drugs and do wrong things. 1 or 2 months ago there a child ordered something from Blinkit and some things happened that the Blinkit boy beat our campus student he was full of blood.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good infrastructure and plenty of clubs.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is the best thing at MIT-WPU. Also, our (biotech students) building of work (maitre, Kashyap) has proper classrooms and labs. I don't know about the hostel as I don't live in a hostel, but some of my friends do. They have said food quality is not so good, also they have other facilities like washing machines and all provided, but still they don't like it much.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the college and faculty.
reviews.review_text: The college has great on-campus hostels with Wi-Fi and all amenities. The library is just mesmerising, its ambience is on another level. Classrooms have a great ambience, as in our department. Mess food is average, but the sports facilities are just amazing. Overall, it's excellent.

reviews.review_heading: My review of this college.
reviews.review_text: The course curriculum was different from the rest of the colleges. There was a brew of finance, operations, marketing, and HR for the elective options. They imparted both theoretical and practical knowledge. It was a very flexible system that favors students for their betterment. The hostel was completely air conditioned and was equipped with free Wi-Fi. There was ample space provided for the balcony and terrace. The rooms were dual sharing with separate washroom facilities for each room. The me...

reviews.review_heading: The college has good and friendly faculty with a fresh environment and campus.
reviews.review_text: Our campus has good facilities of Wi-Fi, smart Google classrooms, and well-stocked libraries. Hostel facilities are designed with hygienic food. Even with the good medical facilities and well-trained doctors. The college also supports sports and various national and international competitions.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely dissatisfied with the faculty.
reviews.review_text: We have a specially designed Vyasa building for CSE branch students. It's definitely amazing, the labs are brand new, and each system actually works. The only thing is that the network connectivity is terrible. The mess is good, but the En Encave Cafe is below average.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements with top-notch infrastructure, but the fees are a little bit on the higher side.
reviews.review_text: Cannot comment on hostel as I am a day scholar. Infrastructure available is of top-notch quality. Many canteens are available on the campus. Library has some limited books and is not up to date.

reviews.review_heading: MIT WPU  This is the reality.
reviews.review_text: There are well-developed and invested labs for different subjects. Campus has Wi-Fi. Library is also very useful and very accessible. Campus has a medical room for emergencies, and the hostels are decent. Hostels are okay, but they are extremely far away from the college. Although the college offers transport, it gets tiring to travel that much every single day.

reviews.review_heading: Review of MIT-WPU.
reviews.review_text: For CSE, we have a new building, and it has top-notch infrastructure. 4 labs on each floor, and each lab has 70 iMac setups. Canteens are really good, and the on-campus café too. We also have a sports complex where the ground floor has a huge swimming pool, which is very clean, and above that is the indoor games floor, like table tennis, and on top, we have a badminton hall.

reviews.review_heading: MIT WPU CSE  Industry oriented curriculum with lively campus culture.
reviews.review_text: College offers smart classrooms, MAC labs, library, and research space. Hostels are not that good but have clean rooms, study areas, and Wi-Fi. Mess food is the worst. Sports and recreation are average, with a decent basketball court, table tennis, and a gym. Overall, the infrastructure supports both academics and student life effectively.

reviews.review_heading: Review of MIT-WPU.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is huge, having lush greenery even after being in the heart of Pune city. The campus provides a canteen, sports ground, swimming pool, table tennis court, badminton court, etc. We have all types of medical facilities available, too.

reviews.review_heading: The campus is a bit small, but infrastructure-wise good, too good a football ground.
reviews.review_text: All labs are equipped with Wi-Fi and cameras, as well as classrooms and a library. There's a well-equipped library as well, with full AC, and all classrooms have 3 AC's. I live in a hostel, so I can answer better. The quality of food is good, sometimes food is so bad, sometimes too good. Some hostel also has sports facilities, so overall okay.

reviews.review_heading: KIET college review by rookie.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is actually good. Labs are modern. Wi-Fi is good when on less traffic. Decently maintained infrastructure. Sports facilities are not good as it is a small campus. Library is decent. Hostel mess food is pretty good. Campus is fully air-conditioned.

reviews.review_heading: Very good college, satisfied with teachers and placements.
reviews.review_text: The hostel and canteens have great food. Each classroom is very spacious. They have AC fans and smart boards in every class. The hall is quite big as well. The structure is really good. It is around 20 acres, but they have planned it very well.

reviews.review_heading: Decent placement with effort, strong campus life, mixed academic experience.
reviews.review_text: Currently, it is in the development phase, but overall, it is nice and clean. Everything that is required for the students and faculty is available in the respective facility areas. Wi-Fi, labs, and classes are all clean and comfortable. The management and maintenance of these facilities are very impressive.

reviews.review_heading: Enough and worth it in comparison to other private colleges.
reviews.review_text: All of the facilities available, like hostels, free campus Wi-Fi 24/7, advanced labs like computer organisation, logical design, micro electronics lab, analogue communication lab, 10 on 10 quality of facilities, library and a book resource centre are also available.

reviews.review_heading: Good placement and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The college provides very good infrastructure for the mechanical engineering students. The labs are well-equipped with modern machines and instruments, classrooms are spacious with projectors and proper ventilation, and the library has a good collection of textbooks, reference books, and digital resources.

reviews.review_heading: A good college at this fee, which provides both knowledge and a "DECENT JOB."
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very good, like every place, it is very well furnished and air-conditioned. There is Wi-Fi available in every part of the campus, and there are separate buildings for different departments. There are two reading halls. One is available till 5 PM and the other one till 2 AM. Labs are good and well-equipped. There are around 5-6 hostels, including both boys' and girls'. The food quality, for me, is mediocre; it's like some days it's good, and some days it can be bad. ISB accepts national-level entrance exams, such asGMAT/GRE/ CAT followed by other course-specific selection rounds. The institute has already started the admission process for its flagship PGP course for the academic year 2025. Candidates seeking admission in ISB Hyderabad must have a valid score in theGMAT/GREexam to secure admission.

The admission process of ISB Hyderabad varies with each course. The selection is based on the score in the entrance exam. Below are the steps to get a seat in ISB Hyderabad:
Step 1:The first step for admission to every course is the application process. Candidates are required to apply online for the course.

Step 2:In the second step, candidates need to qualify for one of the required exams, among GMAT & GRE for PGP and FPM courses. The institute also accepts CAT scores for PGP in Management for Young Leaders.
Step 3:For PGP, candidates will also need to qualify GDPI round for final selection. ISB conducts its own entrance exam followed by an interview for Advanced Management Programme admission.
Step 4:Additionally, admission to Executive FPM and AMP courses is based on merit in the last qualifying exam and pre-defined eligibility.

placement_data.title: ISB Hyderabad Placement Overview 2024
paragraphs: ISB Hyderabad has concluded the placements for its PGP Class of 2024. The batch comprised 870 students with an average work experience of 4.4 years. As per the latest report, 405 companies registered for the ISB placements 2024 and presented 1,208 job offers to the Class of 2024. More than 70 first-time recruiters participated and offered over 190 job offers to the students of the 2024 batch. The top four domains in which the highest number of offers were made during ISB Hyderabad placements 2024 include Consulting, Technology, Finance, Sales & Marketing . Further, 80% of the 2024 batch received a package of more than INR 35 LPA. Additionally, 27 international offers were grabbed during 2024 placements, whereas 31 international offers were made in the academic year 2022-23 . The top recruiters of the Indian School of Business (IBS) Hyderabad over the past two years included Deloitte, Accenture, Airtel, Amazon, Air India, Coforge, Cognizant, EY, EXL, Goldman Sachs, HCL, ICICI Bank, HDFC Bank, ITC , etc.

The ISB placement process takes place for four months. The placement session commences with pre-placement talks by the recruiters to the student body. Students then have to submit their responses through an 'expression of interest (EOI)'. Thereafter, the recruiters shortlist the candidates and send them to the Career Advancement Services team, who get in touch with the students. After this, on-campus and off-campus interviews are conducted. The placement process is conducted within a 10-day window, however, the final interview and process continue for several months.

Free hi speed internet, great library for resources and great facilities for sports are provided by the college.

admission_process.title: UPES School of Business Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: Currently, School of Business,UPES admission 2025 is open. School of Business, UPES, is a constituent school ofUPES. School of Business,UPES offers UG, PG, Integrated and Global courses. These courses are provided across Digital Business, Management, and various other streams. Admission to various courses is based on merit and accepted entrance exam scores. The accepted entrance exams are MAT, XAT, CAT, NMAT, CMAT, UPESMET, CUET-PG, CUET, UGAT, UPESMET UG, and others. To apply, candidates must first visit the official website.

UPES School of Business admission 2025 are open. Admission at both UG and PG level is done based on performance in qualifying exams, GD, and interviews. Along with that, candidates must also fulfil the minimum eligibility requirements of the respective courses. Mentioned below are the UPES course eligibility and selection details:

For admission, a candidate must have a valid score in either of the accepted exams for the applied course. Candidates without a valid score in the national-level exams can take the entrance examination conducted by UPES for management course admissions. UPES School of Business's admission process is a multi-step procedure. Candidates can read on for more details about each of the admission stages:
STEP 1: UPES Application Process 2025

The School of Business accepts applications via online mode. Hence, the eligible candidates can visit its official website to apply. During the form filling, candidates should keep scanned copies of the important documents handy. The application can further be submitted successfully after the fee payment. To apply for the UPESMET exam, candidates can visit the university website only.
STEP 2: Shortlisting of Students
The school further shortlists applications based on the candidate's scores in the accepted examinations. Such students should be informed over mail or through any either medium about the selection.
STEP 3: Portfolio Presentation & Interview

Shortlisted candidates are further required to appear for the portfolio presentation and the interview round. A candidate must participate in these selection rounds for admission. The schedule for the same shall be available on the UPES official website.
STEP 4: Admission Confirmation

In the last step, based on the candidate's academic record, exam score, and performance in the presentation & interview, the final selection is done. Selected candidates may have to pay some fee amount to confirm their admission.

faqs.question: How to get admission at UPES School of Business?
faqs.answer: UPES School of Business  accepts  national-level MBA exams such as CAT/XAT/GMAT/CMAT.Students having a minimum MAT/CMAT 2024  score of 70 percentile will be exempted from the UPES Management Entrance Exam and only be called for an online interview if qualified.A valid 50 percentile and above score in  CAT/XAT, a minimum score of 400 and above in GMAT, and a score of 120 and above in NMAT will also be accepted.Students can also sit for the UPESMET exam. To be eligible to get School of Business UPES Dehradun MBA admission students need 50% marks in 10th,12th, and graduation. Then the students can appear for the UPESMET exam and get secure and valid marks. Selected students are then called for a personal interview. Selected students are allotted seats once they qualify in the interview round.

faqs.question: Does UPES School of Business offer better placements than Doon Business School?
faqs.answer: Comparing UPES to Doon Business School, the Doon Business School has a higher ranking both nationally and internationally. Better industry recognition and reputable recruiters taking part in their placement efforts could result from this.DBS has a dedicated career and placement development cell. It is designed to help and guide students toward achieving the job or internship of their dreams. Apart from this, the institute has organized partnerships like SAP alliance, Coursera and Kriger Research, USA that would help students with skill and career development across their time of study. DBS offers various on-campus industry-oriented training programs in areas like Python, Data Analytics, NISM certifications, Digital Media Marketing certifications, and R-studio. All of these training programs are included in the courses with low fees. According to the 2022 records the placement rate in DBS is 90% with a record the highest package of 24LPA and an average package of 5.5 LPA.

reviews.review_heading: Knowledgeable faculty and support.
reviews.review_text: Everything has Wi-Fi, a good connection, good college life and a view. Hostel life is amazing and has to be seen, and the night view and jamming sessions are the point of attraction.

reviews.review_heading: My college was overall very good.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are fully furnished and the seating arrangement is good in the classrooms. We had full access to the smart boards and everything in the ventilation system was good. The library was fully furnished, and quiet and comfortable seats were there for 9 hr access every day. The library was centralized. Facilities were good in the hostel. Rooms were fully furnished and connected washrooms were available. Some rooms had air conditioning. The food in the mess was good. There was a convenience s...

reviews.review_heading: It is an amazing place to study.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is great. I lived in the campus hostel for 2 years, and rooms are good. The food is well-prepared and delicious. Cleanliness is well-maintained. Wardens are also good. The library area is excellent with good reading space and all amenities. Wi-Fi works amazingly. Classrooms, playgrounds, and everything is good here.

reviews.review_heading: Review of University of Petroleum and Energy Studies.
reviews.review_text: All facilities are provided at the university, and the infrastructure is really good. There are various facilities provided in the hostel. The food is decent, and facilities for all types of sports are provided. The medical facilities are also decent. The college has tied up with a hospital that provides facilities.

reviews.review_heading: The facilities provided are good.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure at SOB is pretty good, with good ventilated rooms for students. There are no air conditioners in the SOB building, but the new building has air conditioners and other facilities. There are two playgrounds and one basketball and volleyball court.

reviews.review_heading: A good experience of UPES.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure in our college are brilliant. The Wi-Fi is fantastic, and the classrooms are well designed and organized. As well, the library has a wide range of books available. The food in the canteen is good. And the sports and games available on campus are quite decent.

reviews.review_heading: UPES, Dehradun: A holistic campus experience for MBA aspirants.
reviews.review_text: Talking about the infrastructure, all the classrooms are equipped with smart boards and projectors along with Wi-Fi facilities and a digital library. Hostel is also good as the food quality is good. There are cafes and food courts available in the college. There are medical facilities provided having a tie up with Synergy hospital for emergencies.

reviews.review_heading: For Global exposure Upes is good, if you have money.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available, the library is open for 10 hours every day, and classrooms are big enough. Mess food is quite decent, and the canteen is a little bit expensive. Medical facilities are available, and many sports and games, like basketball, football, etc., are available.

reviews.review_heading: My journey at UPES (21-24).
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and facilities of Upes Kandoli are up to the mark; everything is well organized; the library is equipped with Wi-Fi and power sockets to ease studies for the students. I haven't applied for a hostel as I am a local, but based on my classmates reviews, it's somewhat okay.

reviews.review_heading: Review of School of Business, UPES.
reviews.review_text:
The college is spread over large areas. The main attraction is the garden, mostly a rock garden. Our cultural festival is famously held in November.
The library is the best part of the university; it is separate; you cannot find data like it anywhere; it is available 24*7.
Classrooms are good, all modern, and digital facilities are available.
Apart from college hostels, many private hostels are within walking distance of the college.
Food options are more all kinds of varieties are here, includi...

reviews.review_heading: Amazing infrastructure and decent quality of education but needs improvement.
reviews.review_text: The campus is tidy with all modern amenities. A Wi-Fi-enabled campus and fully equipped labs are there. Classrooms have air conditioning, smart boards, charging ports, etc. The library is also fully digitised and has a very large collection of books and study materials to choose from. The hostel has spacious rooms with modern amenities, and the food is above average. The quality of food at the campus canteen is good and there is a 24*7 dedicated medical center with a standby ambulance.

reviews.review_heading: Very good university for various reasons.
reviews.review_text: Our college has breathtaking beautiful campus and first rate facilities, There is Wi-Fi available throughout the campus gaurenteeing connectivity. The labs at the college are properly furnished and give students all the tools they need. The college also has a large library with all the necceseary books in it.

reviews.review_heading: Review of School of Business, UPES.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is personally my favorite at UPES; the facilities here are top-class. It's been 2 years, and still, I have no complaints. The hostel is student-friendly, and the food here is just like home. The campus is green and beautiful, with vibes that are very positive, giving students a great environment to study in.

reviews.review_heading: Good campus life, and a great location.
reviews.review_text: The campus's infrastructure is quite good. The library here has all the facilities and books that will help us in our research. There is a good studio, a food court, and three cafes where the food is very tasty. A football field, basketball court, and lawn give different exposure.

reviews.review_heading: Less opportunities are provided.
reviews.review_text:
The college has great infrastructure; they have the proper classrooms, labs and Wi-Fi facilities.
The canteen is also so affordable and the food quantity is also good in Upes. The proper gaming facility is provided; the basketball and volleyball fields are property-maintained.

The UPES’ Free Ships Scholarships are built to uplift prospective students from low-income families without added clauses or strings attached. A total of 51 seats are allotted with an upper age limit of 20 years for UG programs and 25 years for PG programs - and is provided on both, the tuition fee and hostel fee.
Image source: official website
4. Sports Scholarships

The University allotted 50 seats for sportspeople who excel in a range of sports from cricket, football and athletics to shooting, chess and table tennis; as it aims to make sports an inclusive part of the academic curriculum. The scholarship percentile under this impressive initiative ranges from 35% to 100% depending on the number of national & international sports achievements a candidate has.
Image source: official website
5. Academic Scholarship

This scholarship is applicable for both UG and PG students and for the second year onwards. The scholarship will be awarded to 10% of the total students enrolled in each of the programmes or 1 student whichever is higher. The 10% will be rounded off to the nearest next number. Here is the criteria:

hostel_campus.college_name: Adamas University Kolkata Infrastructure Details & Reviews

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of good placement.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure in this college are outstanding. Labs and classrooms are neat and clean, and Wi-Fi provides good speed to students to access the internet for study purposes. Plus, the quality of food is excellent in the hostel as well as in the canteen. Students love to eat the delicious food from the hostel and canteen. They study by making a group in the hostel at night.

reviews.review_heading: It's average. I think they should work on the hostel food.
reviews.review_text: The library is good and well-maintained. The hostel food is not at all good, and even the food available in the Nescafé area is not worth it. They charge too much and provide lower-quality products, and the Nescafé people take a very long time to process orders. This issue should be solved.

reviews.review_heading: There was good placement only in 2023, now the placement is very bad. But campus life is too good.
reviews.review_text: In this case, college is too good. Infrastructure is good. The library is also very good and has a sports facility. There are 4 or 5 libraries with all types of books available. Sports culture is also there. The food is not too good, for the money, and not very good medical support.

reviews.review_heading: Adamas University is one of the best private universities.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are good. Online smart board classrooms are good and big. Labs are all MAC labs. Wi-Fi is available 24/ 7 for students. The hostel room quality is good. The quality of food is too good. They maintain good hygiene. A medical facility is available for 24 hours, and an ambulance is also available. Sports and games also happen every day.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied with the placement records, but the faculty here is well-qualified, nice, and good.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure and hostel facilities are very good here. There are labs, air-conditioned classrooms with smart boards, Wi-Fi is available 24/7 in both classrooms, hostels, and library. The facilities given in the hostel are pretty decent, too, except for the food. Sometimes they make nice food, and sometimes it's not even edible. There are indoor and outdoor games available. Football, cricket, badminton, table tennis, basketball, and volleyball tournaments are conducted every year. The campus is...

reviews.review_heading: Totally satisfied with staying in this college and the faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure were excellent in this course. Labs and classrooms were neat and clean. Wi-Fi had good speed for the students to access the internet. Delicious food like biryani and sandwiches could be found in our canteen. Students go to canteen every day. Hostel life was also good where students study and gossip with each other. Food provided in the hostel was very delicious.

reviews.review_heading: Adamas university's facilities and placement are good.
reviews.review_text: Adamas University facilities are very good. Every problem solution is provided by some facilities. The Wi-Fi problem is not faced. One lab is open any time. Sports and games are played. Football tournaments, volleyball tournaments, and cricket tournaments are available.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the campus is pretty big with a good environment and no ragging at all.
reviews.review_text: I would say it's luxurious and all good. There is no use of mobile phones during classes, and classrooms are digitalized. It is of average quality. I am not from the hostel, but I heard it's average. I looked at the architect, and it is not that big. It is small with few rooms and average room quality (not my opinion).

reviews.review_heading: It has really good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are good for those who want to self-study. In the hostel, the food quality is good. It has a neat and clean infrastructure with 24x7 medical facilities. Students need to get permission to go outside because of security, which is perfect for hostellers.

reviews.review_heading: Adamas University is a reputable institute in West Bengal and is accredited by both NAAC and UGC.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is present indoors and in the library. Most of the classrooms are air-conditioned. The CS lab is equipped with both Macs and PCs. The engineering workshop is equipped with most of the equipment and is used with proper safety precautions taken into action.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the college.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities are better than expected. They are clean most importantly, and everyone around is polite. There are clubs for extracurricular activities, so sports are something our university hugely comes up with. There are quotas for sports people, and they get a chance to play in various events.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college in Bengal.
reviews.review_text: All classrooms have Wi-Fi. There are many labs for every student and 2 libraries where there are many books which all students can access and gain knowledge. We have a medical room and a place to get admitted. There are good doctors for a nice treatment. The hostel food is also good.

reviews.review_heading: It's best college for higher study you can short out.
reviews.review_text: College infrustructure is very good. Hostel is very clean every time the cleaning man comes to clean. Wi-Fi is available everywhere on campus. Classrooms are very clean and also take classes using projectors. Also, library is available and has more than 1,00,000 books available.

reviews.review_heading: The best private university in West Bengal with NAAC A grade.
reviews.review_text: There are too many facilities everything a student needs is here. There are highly advanced labs with Mac machines, fast Wi-Fi, smart classrooms, projectors, etc. Qualities of hostels also you can get AC rooms non-AC rooms and 24/7 Wi-Fi, water, and electricity. You also get vending machines in your hostel to get food it's clean every day and also the canteen food is great quality.

reviews.review_heading: A good psychology college in Kolkata.
reviews.review_text: In our college hostel facility is available, with separate hostels for both boys and girls. But the rules and regulations are kind of strict, which may cause problems for you.

course_faqs.answer: Yes, there is an MBA fee waiver at IILM University, Greater Noida, for female students. paragraphs: IILM 2026 Admissions Open|Apply Now

IILM University admission processconsists of different stages such as application, selection, and admission confirmation. Interested students need to complete all the steps to get admission in the university. Students can check the points below to know detailed IILM admission process 2026:
1. IILM University Greater Noida Application Process 2026

Register online and submit your completed application with academic details. After filling the form, upload the scanned copies of all academic documents. The documents include marksheets, entrance exam scores, Identity Proof, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Pros are excellent industry tie-ups. Cons are high fee structure may not suit all budgets.

reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available include Wi-Fi, labs, and a library, which is fully air-conditioned. It has four boys' hostels and one girls' hostel. There is a cafeteria, which includes North Indian, South Indian, and continental food with good beverages.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and study but placement and all are poor.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely I am very satisfied because of faculty members, average placement since 2020.

Facilities you will get a basketball court, football ground, cricke...

reviews.review_text: The hostel is pretty good. The only thing to compromise is the food, which is not too good here. reviews.review_heading: Excellent placement support.
reviews.review_text: It has well-maintained classrooms with smartboards and a fully equipped library, wi-fi is a bit slow, and modern computer labs that support effective learning. It provides professions environment with seminar halls, project labs, well organized academic facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Review of International institute of Business Studies.
reviews.review_text: We have very good infrastructure and facilities like a library, computer lab, canteen, classrooms, and seminar halls. Every room has a Wi-Fi facility. The college is surveilled with CCTV cameras. It provides all the basic facilities required in a college. Overall, the infrastructure is good.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it’s just a normal, average college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is average. The college looks like a coaching center rather than a large campus. Events are sometimes held in corridors or the gallery. Classrooms are good, well-ventilated, and air-conditioned. Hostel facilities are basic, with food being just average, but manageable.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The college provides us with Wi-Fi, smart board, and library for student use, and laptops are given. The college has exchange programs and interactive sessions. The college gives hostel facility as well for 1 year, and transport is provided as well for a price.

reviews.review_heading: Small infrastructure with extensive knowledge and scope.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is small but has all the facilities related to study. Wi-Fi works fine, and there are 2 computer labs and also Bloomberg terminals, with which you can get certification. There are two libraries. I don’t know about the quality of the hostel and food.

reviews.review_heading: Good academics with decent placements and supportive faculty - IIBS college review 2026.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms have centralized ACs, and the students are extremely comfortable with the libraries and hostel, where we can expect good food and hygiene. Sports are conducted every academic year. Apart from that, indoor games are always available on the campus.

reviews.review_heading: A real PGDM experience at IIBS Bangalore.
reviews.review_text: The campus is neat with good classrooms, a library, and common spaces. Life here is balanced-while academics are rigorous, cultural events, management fests, and clubs make it engaging. It is a good environment to build a peer network and learn teamwork. A new reading room has been allotted, and we have digital library access.

reviews.review_heading: Minimum satisfaction with the faculty, average placements in 2024 .
reviews.review_text: In our course, the infrastructure is good. There are two libraries in the college, various books are available for reading, and the space in the library is spacious and peaceful. In the college, there is a separate common room for girls. A medical room is also available in the college for emergencies, and they provide medicine as well. The infrastructure in the classrooms is also good; there are digital boards.

reviews.review_heading: To summarize, IIBS is a good college for PGDM and MBA, with good facilities for the students.
reviews.review_text: The college has a good infrastructure with tools and equipment. It has seminar halls to conduct events, meetings, or seminars. The college has a good crowd with yearly fests and functions. It includes a library with good quality reference books, hostels for all students and Wi-Fi in each room for the smooth conduct of classes.

reviews.review_heading: A good college experience with balanced academics, supportive faculty, and decent placements.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is decent and well-maintained. Classrooms are spacious with proper seating, Wi-Fi, and projectors. Laboratories are adequately equipped, and the library has a good collection of books and digital resources. Hostel facilities are satisfactory with clean rooms, regular water supply, and acceptable food quality in the mess. Medical and security facilities are also available on campus.

reviews.review_heading: The college campus is small, but placements and faculty members are good.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is small. It includes two computer labs and two libraries. Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus. All classrooms have centralized AC. Students can check attendance and examination results on Digi campus, which allows more flexibility to student

reviews.review_heading: Great learning environment with supportive faculty and strong industry exposure.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of the college is decent and meets the basic requirements for MBA students. The classrooms are clean and equipped with projectors. Wi-Fi is available most of the time. The library has good study material but can be improved with more peaceful space.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of college, faculty and etc.
reviews.review_text: Our college has fully air conditioned classrooms with LCD/ multimedia projectors, audiovisual aids, and smart boards. Well stocked library with a large collection of management, reference books, and national and international journals. Computer lab updated.

reviews.review_heading: I'm satisfied, amazing faculty, and overall a great experience.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is great, the infrastructure is good as well, and the food is okay as well. Facilities like a gym, security 24/7, and parking facilities are also provided. Apart from that, student enjoy their hostel life, so overall it's great, and food generally comes 4 times in a full day.

reviews.review_heading: The college is good for studies and placements, with a good environment.
reviews.review_text: The college has a nice and peaceful environment. It is very good in infrastructure. It is Wi-Fi enabled with a good connection. The food available in the hostel is good, not that bad, and we can manage easily. Sports and games are available in the hostel areas. Overall, it is good.

reviews.review_heading: Great learning experience with strong faculty and excellent facilities.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms equipped with ICT (multimedia), smart boards, Wi-Fi/LAN, PA system, and good ventilation & lighting. Internet access is available across most of the campus. English Communication Lab for language and soft-skills learning. The LRC has a Borrowing Section, Reference Section, and a Journal Section. Many management textbooks, domain-specific/reference books, and journals.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it's a good college for pursuing an MBA.
reviews.review_text: Campus area of our institute is very beautiful. All the facilities are available here, the labs are well-equipped with many computers, and there are great classrooms and a library with a variety of books. Free Wi-Fi is not provided by the college on the campus. Overall, our institute provides good infrastructure.

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure is one of the best in Hyderabad, providing a clean and safe environment.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is excellent, but there are no hostel facilities available. Classrooms and corridors are neat and clean, and the libraries and three labs are just okay. The whole college is equipped with numerous cameras that provide students with security and safety.

reviews.review_heading: Gain practical experience with good placements.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure wise its an excellent college that has a degree + MBA + PGDM with separate blocks including facilities like Wi-Fi, digital classrooms, a big playground, bus facility around Hyderabad, and many more. Our college tied up with Stanza to provide a hostel for students.

reviews.review_heading: Good placement and internship opportunities are provided.
reviews.review_text: The college has labs, Wi-Fi, and classrooms with advanced technology. The college provides online facilities as well. There is a very big library, and all the study material is provided by the college itself. There is no college hostel, but the college is tied up with Stanza Living, and if you want, you can find other accommodations.

reviews.review_heading: It is a college that transforms students into professionals.
reviews.review_text: Every classroom has air conditioning, Wi-Fi, and SMART boards to support modern learning. The college also has a large library with a wide range of books that are very helpful for our studies and academic growth. This makes the classroom engaging, allowing both students and teachers to use digital tools and upgrade their knowledge. The library with various books enables students to explore new things.

reviews.review_heading: Vishwa Vishwani Institute of Systems and Management is the best institute for career guidance.
reviews.review_text: The college provides good infrastructure such as digital boards, AC classrooms with Wi-Fi facilities, computer labs, etc. The college provides a hostel (stanza) for students coming from different states and regions, a canteen with good hygiene and sports (such as Cricket, Badminton, Volleyball, chess, carrom, etc. ). Followed by an annual sports meet (celebration sports day once in a year where the best performers are awarded).

reviews.review_heading: It has good faculty, really good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The campus has everything we need for a smooth learning experience. Facilities like Wi-Fi, smart classrooms, and computer labs make everyday study easy. The library is a quiet spot with plenty of useful books.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied because of my professional career development.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available for our PGDM course are classrooms with Wi-Fi and air-conditioned facilities. It has a huge library with various different kinds of books, daily magazines, and newspapers. Students are offered daily newspapers for real-world experience and the current situation of the world. There are provisions for medical facilities in case of any emergency. There are sports for physical and mental health balance.

reviews.review_heading: It is absolutely privileged to be a part of this college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is great. It has centralized AC classrooms, labs, and Wi-Fi enabled. It is really calm on the campus and surrounded by nature. Facilities are really good. The canteen is also good.

reviews.review_heading: The review stories of VVISM.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good but standards for studies are very outdated and not at all worth investing your time and money. They could have been better for the fees taken. Few teachers are good but the syllabus is outdated and hardly up to the standards.

reviews.review_heading: It has good faculty members, infrastructure, and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The campus features spacious, air-conditioned classrooms and lecture halls. The library houses a vast collection of management books, journals, and magazines. VVISM boasts state-of-the-art computer labs, including the business analytics and simulation lab. The analytics lab is dedicated to enhancing students' proficiency in tools like SAS, R, tableau, and Python. reviews.review_heading: I think my college will fall in the moderate type, like placements and infrastructure  are good.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good but not great. All labs are present like BMMODA and other typo labs, and courses like BBA in Business Analytics and all have other labs.

reviews.review_heading: The college has above-average placements, great faculty and campus, and an average student crowd.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms and areas in the building are well-equipped. The mess grounds are well-maintained. The library, computer labs, and other equipped labs are also well-maintained. The courts are well-maintained. The mess and canteens are good.

reviews.review_heading: An overview of my college.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure are top-notch. The classrooms are fully air-conditioned, Wi-Fi is available, labs are well-equipped, classes have smart boards, and the library is super accessible. Hostel provides many amenities like free Wi-Fi 24/7, AC, laundry, conveyance, and 4 times meals. The quality of food that is given is good. Food is prepared with hygiene. A gym is available in the hostel. A sports area is also there to play badminton.

reviews.review_heading: It gives a good percentage of placements.
reviews.review_text:
Email Helper
They provide many facilities like canteen, A.C. class, smart class, disciplined environment, Wi-Fi, and library, and in our hostel, there are A.C. rooms, laundry service, good quality food in the mess, and a secure environment so that nobody gets scared.

reviews.review_heading: A college with academic excellence, industry connection, and a student-centric approach.
reviews.review_text: The institute has a dedicated central library with a reprography room for the use of students. The institute emphasises quality in classroom teaching and incorporates an IT infrastructure to give both. Students are interactive and facilitate the learning environment.

reviews.review_heading: Lloyd Business School: Empowering future leaders with quality education and vibrant campus life.
reviews.review_text: Lloyd Business School offers modern infrastructure to support academics and student life. Classrooms are equipped with smart boards and audio-visual aids. The library has a vast collection of books and digital resources. Computer labs provide access to the latest software. The campus includes an auditorium for events and high-speed Wi-Fi. Hostel facilities include separate accommodation for male and female students, with well-furnished rooms and nutritious food. Recreational areas offer indoor g...

reviews.review_heading: Best college for everyone.
reviews.review_text: Best infrastructure is available in our college. We have a good hostel, good mess, etc. We have a big playground for sports, and the best thing is our classes are fully AC. In our college, we have such a big library, and Wi-Fi and labs are also available.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Lloyd Business School.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are good as they provide an IBM lab where every desk has a personal computer with a personal key and Wi-Fi. Classrooms are equipped with air conditioner and smart boards for studying. Library is also very good with computers and internet connectivity, along with lots of books. I don't live in the hostel because it is too expensive. They ask for Rs. 1,80,000 per annum, which is like a five-star hotel. So, I live in a PG on rent, which is the best accommodation option. Cafeteria is good...

reviews.review_heading: Overall, I will suggest this college because it's worth taking admission.
reviews.review_text: We have very well-maintained computer labs and a library. Recently, we have new computers built where we have more than 100 computers and new. There we learn about MS Excel and MS Word, Google Sheets. With experienced professionals, we also have all the important books available in the library for academic purposes.

reviews.review_heading: Glad that I took admission in Lloyd.
reviews.review_text:
The facilities at Lloyd Business School are excellent. All classrooms are well mannered and air-conditioned. 
Wifi is also available and labs and library facilities are also very good and all are air conditioned. 
The hostel of Lloyd gives the feeling of a 5-star hotel. Their food is so tasty and healthy for us. 24/7 medical facilities are there. Their sports and events are organized every month in Lloyd.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, this college is a great experience.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is okay but could be better. The Wi-Fi system is not that good, and sports activities and areas could be added or improved. The canteen and library of the college are really good. The hostel is also nice, but the timings could be a little more flexible; otherwise, it's really good.

reviews.review_heading: Our institute is always available for students to support and help them in their career.
reviews.review_text: Our college infrastructure is awesome and the hostel is nice; only food sometimes is below quality, but other things are awesome and our campus has 3 cafeterias, a beautiful ground, a Wi-Fi facility, a game center, an ovation room, study rooms and 2 libraries.

reviews.review_heading: As expected Lloyd doesn't provide that much of placement and return on investment.
reviews.review_text: As compared to the fees of the college, the facilities which they provide are genuine and pocket friendly. There are various facilities available in the campus like Wi-Fi, computer labs, classrooms, library. All things are available, cafeteria is also available.

reviews.review_heading: Everything about Lloyd - campus, faculty, placements.
reviews.review_text: Everything is available in our college except placements. You get a basketball court, a nice playground, library, lab, etc. These facilities are there. You can go for it if you just want to have fun and enjoy your college life, but if you want placement, then I wouldn’t recommend it.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the college is good. Placement is also decent in our course.
reviews.review_text: The college has well-furnished classes and a library. The infrastructure of our college is quite good and decent. It provides facilities like labs, cafeterias, grounds, libraries, etc. Labs are well maintained. The hostel has good facilities like an RO, well-maintained rooms, a mess area and a games area.
